items.name: Swiss International Pro
items.tagline: Grid, Helvetica, red. Nothing else needed.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a one-page agency portfolio in the Swiss International Pro style — grid-obsessed, typographic, ruthlessly aligned.
LOOK: Palette — bg #FAFAF8, surface #FFFFFF, fg #111111, muted #6B6B6B, accent #E30613, accent2 #1A1A1A, border #E3E3DF, no gradient. Load fonts via https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:wght@500;700;800&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap — Inter Tight for display, Inter for body, IBM Plex Mono for metadata. Everything flush left; no centered text anywhere except the CTA band.
LAYOUT: Build in order: (1) sticky top nav — wordmark left, five mono uppercase links right, 1px #E3E3DF bottom border; (2) hero — 4px red rule, mono kicker, 8-column-clamped Inter Tight headline, gray lede, two buttons; (3) stats band — four columns with oversized numerals and mono labels; (4) feature grid — three white cards on hairline borders with index numerals 01/02/03; (5) about — two flush-left paragraphs; (6) CTA band; (7) footer-mega — four columns of mono links.
MOTION: Use GSAP ScrollTrigger: red rules scale-x 0-100% in 500ms cubic-bezier(0.77,0,0.18,1); headlines split-line reveal, 80ms stagger, 600ms each; sections scroll-snap (CSS scroll-snap-type: y proximity); nav underline grows 200ms ease-out.
SIGNATURE: A toggleable 12-column grid overlay button (shows semi-transparent red columns); oversized index numerals set in Inter Tight 800 at 4rem.
CONSTRAINTS: Semantic HTML (header/main/section/footer), responsive single-column under 720px, WCAG AA contrast (#E30613 only on white/light surfaces), no layout shift, defer JS, total under 150KB.

items.name: Editorial Print Masthead
items.tagline: Front-page gravitas, drop caps, column rules.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are building a longform magazine homepage in the Editorial Print Masthead style — broadsheet discipline for the browser.
LOOK: Palette — bg #FBF7EF, surface #FFFFFF, fg #211C15, muted #6E655A, accent #8C2B2B, accent2 #2F4B38, border #E4DCCC, no gradient. Load fonts via https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@500;700;900&family=Source+Serif+4:ital,opsz,wght@0,8..60,400;0,8..60,600;1,8..60,400&family=Courier+Prime:wght@400;700&display=swap — Playfair Display for the masthead and headlines, Source Serif 4 for body at 1.15rem/1.75, Courier Prime for datelines. Drop caps use float + ::first-letter at 3.4em.
LAYOUT: (1) Masthead — centered Playfair wordmark between a 3px top rule and 1px bottom rule, dateline slug in Courier Prime; (2) nav — centered small-caps links; (3) lead essay — two CSS columns with 1px #E4DCCC column-rule, drop cap opening; (4) timeline of recent issues; (5) pull quote band; (6) FAQ-style letters-to-the-editor accordion; (7) footer-mega with archive columns.
MOTION: GSAP ScrollTrigger + DrawSVGPlugin: rules draw left-to-right 600ms ease-out; drop caps settle from scale 1.05, 700ms; masthead letter-spacing eases .2em to normal on load, 900ms; pull quotes rise 20px, 800ms, triggered at 40% visibility.
SIGNATURE: The double-rule dateline band; true column rules between essay columns; a centered pull quote set in italic Playfair between hairlines.
CONSTRAINTS: Semantic article/section/figure markup, hyphens:auto with text-wrap:balance on headlines, AA contrast for #6E655A on #FBF7EF, columns collapse to one under 720px, images lazy-loaded.

items.name: Bauhaus Revival
items.tagline: Primary geometry, honest structure, zero ornament.
items.prompt:
ROLE: Build a design-school marketing site in the Bauhaus Revival style — primary geometry doing the work of decoration.
LOOK: Palette — bg #F5F0E8, surface #FFFFFF, fg #1A1A1A, muted #6F6A61, accent #D93A2B (red), accent2 #1F5AA8 (blue), plus a tertiary yellow #F2B705 used sparingly, border #D8D1C4, no gradients. Load fonts via https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo+Black&family=Work+Sans:wght@400;500;700&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap — Archivo Black display, Work Sans body, Space Mono for numbering. Buttons are rectangles with border-radius:0.
LAYOUT: (1) nav — thick black bottom border, square logo block; (2) hero — flush-left Archivo Black headline, geometric composition of overlapping circle/triangle/square on the right; (3) motif march strip — animated row of shapes; (4) feature grid — three white cards with 2px black borders and shape icons; (5) numbered about section with section plates 01/02; (6) application form-stack; (7) footer-mega.
MOTION: CSS clip-path reveals — shapes animate inset(100%) to inset(0) 600ms cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1) staggered 100ms on intersection; cards tilt rotateX 8deg toward cursor 300ms ease-out; motif strip translates infinitely at 40px/s; GSAP stagger-drops cards -20px, 90ms apart.
SIGNATURE: The circle-triangle-square motif bar repeated as section dividers; flat primary-color blocks behind alternating sections; numbered section plates in Space Mono.
CONSTRAINTS: Semantic HTML, prefers-reduced-motion disables all animation, shapes are inline SVG or pure CSS (no images), single-column under 720px, AA contrast for body text, ship under 120KB.

items.name: Art Deco Luxe
items.tagline: Gatsby gold on black, symmetry as luxury.
items.prompt:
ROLE: Build a luxury hotel / event site in the Art Deco Luxe style — Gatsby gold, bilateral symmetry, candlelit restraint.
LOOK: Palette — bg #14110E, surface #1E1913, fg #F3E9D2, muted #9C8A63, accent #C9A227, accent2 #E8D9A8, border #3A3226; gradient linear-gradient(135deg,#C9A227,#F3E9D2,#C9A227) reserved for text sheens and dividers. Load fonts via https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@400;600;700&family=Jost:wght@300;400;500&display=swap — Cinzel engraved caps for display (letter-spacing .12em), Jost for body. All hero and section headings centered; body copy centered or justified.
LAYOUT: (1) nav — centered links flanking a monogram crest, hairline gold bottom border; (2) hero — SVG sunburst behind the headline, engraved capitals, two gold-outline buttons; (3) stepped-border suite cards (pricing-tiers style) with gold-framed imagery; (4) experience story section; (5) FAQ accordion with chevron ornaments; (6) reservation CTA; (7) footer-mega with a monogram marquee strip.
MOTION: GSAP + DrawSVG — sunburst rays draw 1s ease-out, 40ms stagger; headline sheen sweeps via background-position keyframes every 6s; content fades up 24px, 700ms, 120ms stagger; monogram marquee 30px/s pausing on hover.
SIGNATURE: Stepped ziggurat borders on cards and section rules; the sunburst motif recurring in nav, hero, and footer; letter-spaced engraved capitals everywhere.
CONSTRAINTS: Semantic HTML, focus-visible outlines in #C9A227, AA contrast (#F3E9D2 on #14110E passes; never set #9C8A63 below 1rem), responsive to single column under 720px, SVG ornaments under 20KB total.

items.name: Midcentury Modern Eames
items.tagline: Atomic optimism in mustard, teal, and terrazzo.
items.prompt:
ROLE: Build a midcentury modern furniture e-commerce homepage in the Midcentury Modern Eames style.
LOOK: Palette — bg #F6F1E5, surface #FFFFFF, fg #2B2B26, muted #7A7466, accent #E0A426 (mustard), accent2 #2A6F77 (teal), border #E3DCCB; gradient linear-gradient(135deg,#E0A426,#C97A2B) for badges only. Load fonts via https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,500;9..144,700&family=Work+Sans:wght@400;500;600&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap — Fraunces soft-serif display, Work Sans body, Space Mono for prices and labels. Rounded corners (12px) on cards and photos; flat colors, subtle paper grain everywhere.
LAYOUT: (1) nav — cream bar, teal underline hover; (2) hero — split layout, headline + mustard CTA left, atomic-orbit composition and framed chair photo right; (3) terrazzo divider band; (4) product-card row of three (lounge, lamp, sideboard) with starburst badges and Space Mono prices; (5) testimonial-wall — three quote cards on teal-tinted surface; (6) stats band with count-ups; (7) footer-mega.
MOTION: Orbit rings rotate 360° per 24s linear (CSS); starburst badges pop scale .8 to 1, 300ms spring cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) on hover; stats count up over 1.2s ease-out via GSAP; feTurbulence grain drifts 12px per 8s.
SIGNATURE: The atomic orbit motif in hero and footer; terrazzo divider bands (SVG turbulence + scattered ellipses); starburst badges on new items.
CONSTRAINTS: Semantic product markup with aria-labels, alt text on all photos, single column under 720px, grain overlay must be pointer-events:none and opacity under 0.06, AA contrast for #7A7466 on cream.

items.name: Brutalist Press
items.tagline: Default styles, radical honesty, zero polish.
items.prompt:
ROLE: Build a manifesto zine site in the Brutalist Press style — the refusal to decorate is the design. Use as little CSS as honesty allows.
LOOK: Palette — bg #FFFFFF, surface #FFFFFF, fg #000000, muted #555555, accent #0000EE (default link blue), accent2 #FF0000 (sparingly, for one alert), border #000000. Fonts: system stacks only — display 'Times New Roman', serif; body 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; mono 'Courier Prime', monospace, loaded via https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Courier+Prime&display=swap — system stacks take precedence over webfonts. No border-radius anywhere.
LAYOUT: (1) nav — plain monospace links separated by ' | ', underlined, default blue; (2) ticker — 2px black-bordered marquee, Courier, scrolling 60px/s; (3) hero — huge Times bold uppercase headline flush left, plain paragraph, a blinking underscore; (4) data-table of back issues with fully visible 1px black borders; (5) FAQ as definition lists with hr separators; (6) footer-mega of blue underlined links including 'view source'.
MOTION: Hover-invert on links and table rows — background #000, color #FFF, transition 0ms; marquee via CSS keyframes linear infinite; browser-default focus outlines left untouched; one steps(1) blinking cursor at 1Hz.
SIGNATURE: The exposed table borders; a footer line reading 'This page uses no JavaScript frameworks. View source.'; red #FF0000 used exactly once, on the 'OUT NOW' alert.
CONSTRAINTS: Valid HTML5, works with CSS disabled (progressive enhancement), no external images, AA contrast trivially satisfied, total page under 40KB, zero dependencies.

items.name: Grotesk Type Poster
items.tagline: Type so big it becomes architecture.
items.prompt:
ROLE: Build a campaign / music release site in the Grotesk Type Poster style — type is the entire design; no photography.
LOOK: Palette — bg #F2F0EC, surface #FFFFFF, fg #0C0C0C, muted #6E6A64, accent #FF3B00, accent2 #1414FF, border #DEDBD3, no gradient. Load fonts via https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Anton&family=Archivo:wght@400;500;600&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap — Anton for the poster headline, Archivo for everything else, IBM Plex Mono for captions. Headlines: uppercase, line-height 0.9, letter-spacing -0.01em, sized with clamp(4rem,14vw,13rem) so they bleed to the margins.
LAYOUT: (1) nav — hairline bottom border, mono links; (2) hero — one viewport-filling Anton word or phrase, rotated vertical caption on the right edge, oversized outline numeral behind; (3) hairline index table (dates/venues/links) with instant hover-invert rows; (4) quote wall — large pull lines in Anton at 3rem; (5) stats band in condensed numerals; (6) footer-mega with a velocity ticker strip.
MOTION: Variable-font squeeze — headline font-variation-settings 'wght' maps to scroll velocity via GSAP ScrollTrigger getVelocity; lines mask-reveal upward 700ms, 120ms stagger on load; ticker speed = base 60px/s multiplied by scroll velocity, direction flips on upscroll; table rows invert instantly (0ms) on hover.
SIGNATURE: The headline literally touching all four viewport edges; rotated side captions; exactly one blue #1414FF link on the page.
CONSTRAINTS: Semantic HTML, headline remains selectable text (no SVG outline text), clamp() prevents overflow at any width, reduced-motion freezes the ticker, AA contrast, no images shipped at all.

items.name: Retro-Futurist Print
items.tagline: Tomorrow-land optimism, sixty years early.
items.prompt:
ROLE: Build a podcast-network homepage in the Retro-Futurist Print style — 1962 tomorrow-land optimism with modern layout.
LOOK: Palette — bg #F7EFDF, surface #FFFDF6, fg #4A3B28, muted #8E7B5A, accent #E86A33 (burnt orange), accent2 #7A8B4F (avocado), border #E3D5B8; gradient linear-gradient(135deg,#E86A33,#F2B341) on primary buttons and badges. Load fonts via https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Righteous&family=Karla:wght@400;500;700&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap — Righteous rounded display, Karla body, Space Mono for episode numbers. Buttons and cards are pill-shaped (border-radius 999px / 20px).
LAYOUT: (1) nav — cream bar with avocado hover underlines; (2) hero — headline + orange pill CTA left, animated orbit diagram with rocket and dotted path right; (3) feature-grid of three episode cards with starburst 'NEW' badges; (4) pricing-tiers for membership (Listener / Member / Patron) as rounded panels; (5) FAQ accordion with plus-icon orbits; (6) subscribe CTA band with drawn dotted arrow; (7) footer-mega.
MOTION: SVG offset-path — satellite dots ride elliptical paths 18s linear infinite; dotted flight-path arrows stroke-draw 900ms ease-out on scroll (GSAP ScrollTrigger); rocket bobs translateY ±8px, 3s ease-in-out infinite; membership stats count up 1.1s ease-out inside outlined circles.
SIGNATURE: The elliptical orbit diagram recurring in hero and footer; starburst badges; dotted arrows that literally draw the eye toward the CTA.
CONSTRAINTS: Semantic HTML, aria-live on the count-up stats, prefers-reduced-motion stops all loops, single column under 720px, AA contrast (#8E7B5A only at 1rem or larger), no external images — all illustration inline SVG.

items.name: Victorian Almanac
items.tagline: Engraved ornament on aged paper, by candlelight.
items.prompt:
ROLE: Build a heritage whiskey brand site in the Victorian Almanac style — engraved ornament, aged paper, antiquarian density.
LOOK: Palette — bg #F1E8D4, surface #F8F1E1, fg #3B2F23, muted #8A7A63, accent #7B2D26 (oxblood), accent2 #55613B (botanical green), border #D8C7A4, no gradient. Load fonts via https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+SC:wght@400;600;700&family=EB+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;1,400&display=swap — Cormorant SC small-caps for display, EB Garamond for body and italic annotations. Add a subtle paper grain via an SVG feTurbulence overlay at opacity 0.05.
LAYOUT: (1) nav — centered small-caps links under a double rule; (2) hero — engraved filigree flourish, Cormorant wordmark, wax seal stamp, headline in Garamond italic; (3) the story as a timeline of decades; (4) almanac data-table of bottlings (age, cask, proof) with double-rule borders; (5) tasting notes with botanical green annotations; (6) FAQ accordion styled as index questions; (7) footer-mega with copperplate contact script.
MOTION: SVG stroke-draw — filigree borders animate stroke-dashoffset over 1.2s ease-out on section entry (GSAP); wax seal presses scale 1.3 to 1, rotate -4° to 0°, 400ms cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2) on load; flourishes fade with blur(4px) to 0, 900ms; table rows slide in 12px with 60ms stagger.
SIGNATURE: The wax seal that stamps once on load; double-ruled almanac tables; fleuron dividers between every section.
CONSTRAINTS: Semantic HTML, tables with proper th scope, print stylesheet (the page must look right on paper), single column under 720px, ornament SVGs inline and under 30KB, AA contrast for #8A7A63 at 1rem and above.

items.name: Japanese Minimal Ma
items.tagline: Emptiness as composition; one accent, held breath.
items.prompt:
ROLE: Build an architecture studio portfolio in the Japanese Minimal Ma style — negative space as the primary material.
LOOK: Palette — bg #FBFAF6, surface #FFFFFF, fg #1C1C1C, muted #9B968C, accent #B3402E (vermillion), accent2 #5B6E63 (moss), border #E7E3DA, no gradient. Load fonts via https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Shippori+Mincho:wght@400;500;600&family=Zen+Kaku+Gothic+New:wght@300;400;500&display=swap — Shippori Mincho display, Zen Kaku Gothic New body. Keep 60% or more of every viewport empty; content max-width 34em; no boxes, few borders.
LAYOUT: (1) nav — no bar, four small links top-right and a wordmark top-left; (2) hero — one Mincho sentence placed low-left, vertical tategaki caption on the right margin, vermillion seal below; (3) philosophy section with a slowly drawn enso circle; (4) works list — text-only index rows (project, year, location) with hairline rules; (5) image-lightbox gallery — full-bleed single photos with generous margins; (6) contact form-stack (three fields, hairline underlines, no boxes); (7) footer-mega reduced to three lines.
MOTION: SVG stroke-draw — brush rules and the enso animate stroke-dashoffset over 1.4-1.8s ease-in-out via IntersectionObserver; text fades up 10px over 1.2s with 300ms delay; vertical captions slide down 12px once; nothing loops, nothing bounces.
SIGNATURE: The self-drawing enso; the vermillion seal as the only saturated color on the page; vertical text accents in writing-mode: vertical-rl.
CONSTRAINTS: Semantic HTML, lang attributes for Japanese text, focus states visible on hairline inputs, single column under 720px, images lazy-loaded with width and height set, page weight under 200KB.

items.name: Linear Precision
items.tagline: Keyboard-first density on deep lavender-gray glass.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior product engineer building a marketing and app surface for a project-management tool in the Linear Precision style — quiet, dense, keyboard-first, obsessively organized.
LOOK: near-black #08090D background, panels in #101218, primary text #E2E4ED, secondary #8A8F98, hairlines #23252E, indigo accent #5E6AD2 with lighter #9CA1F0 for hovers. Radii are tight: 6px on cards, 4px on buttons — nothing pill-shaped. Import fonts: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap — Inter at -0.01em letter-spacing for UI, JetBrains Mono for keyboard chips, IDs and code. A faint radial lavender glow (rgba(94,106,210,.18)) sits behind the hero.
LAYOUT: slim 56px sticky top bar with product mark, breadcrumb center, avatar cluster right; below it a two-pane layout — 240px icon+label sidebar, main column with a filter row of kbd chips, then a dense issue table (32px rows, hover reveals accent bar); a marketing hero above with headline, one paragraph, dual CTAs and a screenshot frame.
MOTION: View Transitions API for route swaps (90ms fade out, 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) slide up in); command palette springs from 0.97 scale + 6px offset over 160ms ease-out; row hover tint rgba(255,255,255,.03) at 70ms; stat counters count up 700ms ease-out with tabular-nums. Use no animation library — CSS transitions plus 30 lines of vanilla JS suffice.
SIGNATURE: (1) a working ⌘K palette with fuzzy filter and grouped results; (2) kbd chips (1px border, 4px radius, JetBrains Mono 11px) beside every action; (3) left accent bar scaleY animation on active/hover rows; (4) tabular-nums everywhere numbers appear.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML5 with proper nav/main/table landmarks; WCAG AA contrast (verify #8A8F98 on #101218); responsive — sidebar collapses to icon rail under 900px, single column under 640px; prefers-reduced-motion disables palette spring and counters; all keyboard navigation works (Tab, arrows in palette); no layout shift from font loading (font-display: swap + metric fallbacks); images lazy-loaded, total JS under 15KB.

items.name: Vercel Mono Docs
items.tagline: Black, white, mono. Nothing else survives.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building documentation for an infrastructure API in the Vercel Mono Docs style — monochrome, monospace-only, ruthlessly minimal.
LOOK: pure #000000 background, #0A0A0A code surfaces, white #FFFFFF headings, #888888 body text, #333333 hairline borders. NO accent color exists — hierarchy comes from size, weight and spacing only. Import fonts: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Geist+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap — Geist Mono is the display, body AND mono face; set body at 15px/1.7, headings at -0.02em tracking.
LAYOUT: 56px top bar with wordmark left, ⌘K search trigger right; below, a 3-pane docs shell — 220px mono TOC list, fluid article column (max 720px), 200px right rail of section anchors; article anatomy: h2 sections with block-cursor suffix, code fences with filename header bars ($ deploy.config.yaml), parameter tables with 1px #333333 row rules, callout blocks prefixed 'NOTE:'. Marketing hero is optional; when present keep it three mono lines and one white button.
MOTION: deliberately sparse — link underlines grow left-to-right 160ms linear; copy buttons swap label instantly (no fade) and revert after 1.2s; sections fade+rise 8px over 220ms ease-out via IntersectionObserver, firing once; heading cursors blink 1.06s steps(2) infinite. No transforms beyond the reveal, no easing curves beyond linear/ease-out.
SIGNATURE: (1) every text element in the same mono face; (2) $ prompt-prefixed terminal blocks with filename bars; (3) blinking block cursor terminating h2s; (4) pure black-white discipline — audit and reject any color.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML (nav, main, article, aside); WCAG AAA body contrast (#888888 on black is 7:1+ — verify); keyboard-first TOC navigation; responsive: rails collapse under 900px, article goes full-width with sticky top bar under 640px; prefers-reduced-motion kills blinks and reveals; zero images, zero icon fonts — ASCII glyphs only; ship under 10KB CSS+JS.

items.name: Stripe Fintech Clean
items.tagline: Featherweight type, mesh gradients, code as hero.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building the marketing site for a payments API in the Stripe Fintech Clean style — airy, precise, trustworthy, code-forward.
LOOK: deep navy #0A0B1E base, raised surfaces #12142E, text #E8EAF6 with muted #9FA3C8, hairlines #23264A, signature indigo #635BFF accent and cyan #00D4FF secondary. Import fonts: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=Inter+Tight:wght@300;400&family=Fira+Code:wght@400;500&display=swap — Inter Tight at weight 300 for display (clamp 2.6–4.5rem, -0.03em tracking), Inter 400 for body, Fira Code for all code and metric labels. The hero backdrop is a mesh gradient: three blurred (80px) radial blobs in indigo/cyan/violet drifting slowly.
LAYOUT: 64px translucent sticky nav (backdrop-blur 12px) with product dropdowns and a gradient 'Start now' button; full-viewport hero split 50/50 — left: weight-300 headline, one paragraph, dual CTA (solid indigo + ghost), compliance badge row; right: a code card showing a charge creation snippet with syntax colors. Below: 4-column feature grid, a stats band with three count-up numbers (tabular-nums), an about strip with logos row, mega footer with 5 link columns.
MOTION: mesh blobs drift on 26s/34s/42s ease-in-out infinite alternate; numbers count 0→target over 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) triggered at 40% viewport via IntersectionObserver; hero code types at 24ms/char with blinking caret; feature cards lift -4px over 200ms ease-out with border-color transition. Vanilla JS only, no animation library.
SIGNATURE: (1) the mesh gradient trio behind hero; (2) code snippet and product mock given equal billing in the split hero; (3) weight-300 display typography; (4) PCI/SOC2/ISO badge trust row directly under CTAs.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML5 landmarks; WCAG AA on all text (verify #9FA3C8 on #12142E); responsive split hero stacks under 900px, grid becomes single column under 640px; prefers-reduced-motion freezes blobs and disables typewriter/count-up (render final values); font-display swap with size-adjust fallbacks to prevent CLS; lazy-load nothing above fold; total JS < 20KB.

items.name: Notion Warm Docs
items.tagline: Warm paper, emoji icons, content does the talking.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a documentation wiki in the Notion Warm Docs style — warm, human, content-first, zero chrome.
LOOK: warm paper #FBF9F4 background (fade to #F5F0E6 at page bottom), white #FFFFFF cards, ink #2F2B26 headings, muted #78716A body-secondary, borders #E8E2D6, coral #C96F4A links, sage #5B8A72 for tags/success. Import fonts: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Lora:wght@500;600&family=Karla:wght@400;500;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400&display=swap — Lora 600 for headings, Karla for body (16px/1.7), IBM Plex Mono for inline code. Emoji ARE the icon system — 📘 docs, 💡 tips, ✅ done, 🧭 nav; never use an icon font.
LAYOUT: top bar 60px with wordmark, rounded pill search field, and 'New page' button; below, 240px TOC sidebar (paper-tone, pill highlight on active entry) + 720px content column with 96px section rhythm; content anatomy: emoji-prefixed h2s, tip callouts (soft #F0E9DC, 12px radius, 💡 label), checklist blocks (✅), inline mono chips. End with a warm CTA band and 4-column footer.
MOTION: page/route swaps use the View Transitions API — 100ms fade out, incoming rises 10px over 200ms cubic-bezier(.3,.7,.4,1); emoji bullets nudge scaleX(1.25) rotate(-6deg) 180ms spring on item hover; callouts slide in 12px from left + fade over 240ms ease-out via IntersectionObserver once; the TOC active pill slides between entries over 180ms. Vanilla JS + CSS only.
SIGNATURE: (1) emoji as the entire icon system; (2) warm paper texture and cream fade; (3) serif-over-sans typographic pairing; (4) generous whitespace as the primary luxury signal.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML (nav, main, article, aside); WCAG AA — verify #78716A on #FBF9F4 ≥ 4.5:1 for body-sized text; emoji get aria-labels when informative; responsive: TOC collapses to a sticky top-chip row under 900px; prefers-reduced-motion kills transitions and reveals; system emoji rendering means no emoji webfont; total payload under 120KB.

items.name: Arc Browser Playful
items.tagline: Paint-chip gradients meet oversized, bouncy delight.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building the landing page for a consumer app in the Arc Browser Playful style — joyful, physical, springy, immaculately polished.
LOOK: deep plum #1A1423 base, raised surfaces #261D33, text #FFF4F9 with muted #B8A8C8, borders #3A2C4E. The signature palette is the paint-chip gradient: linear-gradient(135deg,#FF6B9D 0%,#C084FC 45%,#7EE8FA 100%) used on hero panels, buttons and orbs. Import fonts: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:opsz,wght@12..96,400;12..96,600;12..96,800&family=Nunito+Sans:wght@400;600;700&display=swap — Bricolage Grotesque 800 for display (clamp 2.8–5rem, -0.02em), Nunito Sans for body. All radii are oversized: 24px panels, 999px pills.
LAYOUT: floating pill nav (centered, backdrop-blur, 999px radius) with logo, links and gradient CTA; hero is a giant 24px-radius gradient panel containing headline + subcopy + dual CTAs, with two smaller tilted panels peeking behind; a 3-card feature row of tilted candy surfaces; an onboarding-steps strip (3 numbered steps with spring-in); playful mega footer.
MOTION: everything springs, nothing snaps — hover pop scale 1.03 and press squash (scaleX 1.06/scaleY .94) over 120ms cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); hero panel enters 0.6→1.04→0.98→1 over 700ms; a 300px gradient orb lags the cursor at lerp 0.08/frame with mix-blend-mode:screen; emoji decorations wiggle ±8deg 1.6s infinite alternate; primary CTA click fires a 24-particle CSS confetti burst (transform-based, cleaned up after 1.2s). Vanilla JS only.
SIGNATURE: (1) paint-chip gradient as the identity surface; (2) chewy spring button physics on every interactive element; (3) cursor-chasing light orb; (4) oversized 24px radii everywhere — audit and reject any small radius.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML5; WCAG AA — verify #B8A8C8 on #1A1423; responsive: hero panel text scales down fluidly, grid single column under 700px, orb hidden on touch devices; prefers-reduced-motion disables springs, orb and wiggle; keyboard focus rings visible (2px #7EE8FA offset); no images — gradients and emoji only; total JS < 12KB.

items.name: Apple Keynote Minimal
items.tagline: Cinematic black stage, product as the only star.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a flagship product page in the Apple Keynote Minimal style — a cinematic black stage where the product is the only star.
LOOK: pure #000000 background, raised surface #0D0D0F, text #F5F5F7, muted #86868B, hairlines #1D1D20, single accent #2997FF used ONLY for links and one CTA — never for fills. Import fonts: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap — Inter stands in for SF Pro: weight 600–700 display at clamp(3rem,7vw,5.5rem) with -0.02em tracking, body 17px/1.5 at weight 400. A faint radial blue glow (rgba(41,151,255,.14)) rises from the bottom of the hero.
LAYOUT: slim 48px translucent nav (blur 20px, rgba(0,0,0,.7)) with tiny 12px links; full-viewport hero: headline top, product visual center (CSS-drawn device or gradient-lit panel — no external images), one sub-line, two text links ('Learn more >' style); then alternating full-viewport sections — each with exactly ONE message: a short headline + one paragraph + product visual; a spec band (4 stats, thin dividers); closing CTA; minimal footer with 12px muted links.
MOTION: scroll-driven animation — product visuals scale 0.92→1 with opacity 0→1 over 100px scroll range (CSS animation-timeline: view(); JS IntersectionObserver fallback); text crossfades with 500ms opacity + 20px rise; hero ambient visual scales 1→1.06 over 20s ease-in-out alternate; spec rows stagger 80ms apart fading 400ms each. Keep timings slow and cinematic — nothing under 400ms.
SIGNATURE: (1) one-message-per-viewport discipline; (2) product lit by a single rim glow on pure black; (3) blue link-only accent; (4) scroll-linked scale reveals that make the page feel edited like film.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML5; WCAG AA (#86868B on black passes 4.5:1 — verify); responsive: hero type scales via clamp, sections keep full-viewport rhythm on mobile with reduced padding; prefers-reduced-motion renders final states statically; video/poster lazy-loaded below fold; cumulative layout shift zero — reserve media aspect boxes; total JS < 8KB with CSS-only path preferred.

items.name: Airbnb Humanist
items.tagline: Rounded warmth, coral accents, photography leads every card.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a travel marketplace in the Airbnb Humanist style — warm, photographic, trustworthy, transactionally crisp.
LOOK: white #FFFFFF base, soft gray #F7F7F7 surfaces, ink #222222, secondary #717171, hairlines #DDDDDD. Coral #FF385C is reserved for the wordmark, save-hearts and one primary CTA — never for text fills. Teal #00A699 marks availability and success. Import fonts: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Nunito:wght@600;700;800&family=Nunito+Sans:wght@400;600&display=swap — Nunito 700–800 for headings and buttons (Cereal stand-in), Nunito Sans for body. Border radius: 16px cards, 999px pills, 8px small controls.
LAYOUT: transparent-over-photo sticky nav that gains white bg on scroll: logo, pill search 'Where to? — Add dates — Add guests' center, 'Become a host' + avatar right; hero is an edge-to-edge photo with the search pill floating over it; below, a filter-chips row then a responsive listing grid (aspect-ratio 4/3 photos, heart button top-right, title/location/rating/dates/price lines); infinite-feel carousels per category; a 'host' promo band; mega footer.
MOTION: carousels drag with pointer events (momentum friction 0.92, 320ms ease-out snap, cloned edges for infinite loop); heart pop 1→1.3→1 over 260ms cubic-bezier(.3,1.4,.5,1) filling coral; card photos zoom 1.08 over 280ms ease-out on hover; search pill expands to a full panel 280ms ease-out with 60ms-staggered child fades. Vanilla JS only.
SIGNATURE: (1) photography leads — every card is 70% image; (2) coral gradient used sparingly for brand moments only; (3) rounded humanist type on everything; (4) the bouncy heart as the emotional signature.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML (nav, main, article, ul lists); WCAG AA — #717171 on white passes; hearts are <button aria-pressed>; carousels keyboard-accessible (arrow keys) with visible focus; responsive: 4-col grid → 2 → 1; nav search collapses to icon under 900px; prefers-reduced-motion disables momentum and pops; images lazy-loaded with LQIP placeholder backgrounds; total JS < 18KB.

items.name: Figma Canvas Native
items.tagline: The page is an infinite canvas — you're a cursor on it.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a landing page for a collaborative design tool in the Figma Canvas Native style — the website itself behaves like an infinite multiplayer canvas.
LOOK: light canvas #F5F5F5 covered in a 24px dot grid (radial-gradient dots, #D4D4D4), frames on white #FFFFFF with 1px #E0E0E0 borders, ink #1E1E1E, secondary #6E6E6E, selection/primary blue #0D99FF, orange-red #F24E1E secondary. Import fonts: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Roboto+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap — Inter for all UI, Roboto Mono for measurement labels, zoom pill and coordinates. Radii small: 8px frames, 6px controls — this is tooling chrome, not consumer softness.
LAYOUT: a top toolbar 48px styled like an editor (logo, tool icons, share button, avatar cluster); hero is a large white frame with the headline inside it, complete with a selection outline + handles and a '1200 × auto' measurement label above; features are three frames in a row, each selectable; a multiplayer strip with live ghost cursors and a comment pin; onboarding steps styled as layers in a layers-panel sidebar motif; CTA frame; minimal footer styled as a status bar (zoom left, page name center, collaborators right).
MOTION: background dot grid pans opposite the mouse at rate 0.03 via rAF lerp 0.1 — infinite canvas depth; 3 ghost cursors ease toward random waypoints (lerp 0.04, new waypoint every 4-9s) with name tags in #0D99FF/#F24E1E/#8A38F5; clicking any frame draws a selection box whose dashed border march-ants at 20 steps/s; zoom pill recalculates percentage from scroll (clamped 50–150%), click smooth-scrolls to top in 400ms.
SIGNATURE: (1) the dotted infinite grid with mouse parallax; (2) selection boxes with corner handles + march-ants on interactive frames; (3) ghost multiplayer cursors that never stop; (4) mono measurement labels and live zoom percentage.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML; WCAG AA contrast on all frame text; selection visuals are decorative — keep real focus states separate and visible; responsive: toolbar collapses to logo+share under 800px, parallax and ghost cursors disabled on touch/reduced-motion; ghost cursors aria-hidden; canvas pan never causes horizontal scroll (overflow hidden, will-change on one layer); total JS < 15KB.

items.name: Intercom Conversational
items.tagline: Every section answers like a friend in chat.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a support-platform marketing site in the Intercom Conversational style — the page itself is a friendly chat conversation.
LOOK: white #FFFFFF base, chat surfaces #F2F6FB, ink #1F2A44, secondary #5B6B8C, borders #DCE4F0, primary blue #2D6FF7, success teal #28C76F. Import fonts: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400&display=swap — Manrope everywhere (800 display, 400 body); JetBrains Mono only for timestamps. Radii are chat-native: bubbles 18px (14px on sender-corner), buttons 12px, FAB circular.
LAYOUT: slim 60px nav with logo, links and 'Start free' gradient pill; hero staged AS a chat: a phone-frame-style panel where brand bubbles and user bubbles alternate telling the product story, ending with a quick-reply chip row; the real CTA lives in chat ('[ Book a demo ]' as a chip); following sections are 'threads' — each opens with a brand bubble (headline) and answers with user bubbles (feature bullets); FAQ is a conversation with expandable reply bubbles; footer keeps a slim chat-echo bar.
MOTION: bubbles spring in on scroll — translateY(14px) scale(.95)→1 over 320ms cubic-bezier(.34,1.4,.5,1), 140ms stagger; before each brand bubble a 3-dot typing indicator bounces (900ms cycle, 120ms stagger) then swaps; the messenger FAB idles at ±4px bob every 3s and its panel springs from bottom-right 0.9→1 over 220ms; read receipts shift ✓→✓✓ in teal 800ms after a user bubble lands. Vanilla JS + CSS only.
SIGNATURE: (1) the entire narrative told in alternating chat bubbles; (2) persistent messenger launcher with opening panel; (3) typing dots before every brand reply; (4) quick-reply chips as navigation/CTA.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML — chat is a real conversation (use role='log' aria-live='polite' for the chat region); WCAG AA contrast; FAB opens a real focusable panel (Esc closes, focus returns); responsive: chat panel goes full-width under 640px, nav collapses; prefers-reduced-motion removes springs/bobbing and shows all bubbles instantly; no external images — avatars are colored initials; total JS < 14KB.

items.name: Shopify Commerce Clean
items.tagline: Trust-first retail: crisp cards, frictionless cart, green go.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building an e-commerce storefront in the Shopify Commerce Clean style — trust-first retail where every pixel earns the checkout.
LOOK: white #FFFFFF base, cards #F6F6F7 with 1px #E1E3E5 borders and 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.05) shadows, ink #1A1A1A, secondary #6D7175. Commerce green #008060 is THE action color — every Add-to-cart, checkout step and success state; #5C5F62 for neutral secondary. Import fonts: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap — Inter everywhere (600 headings, 700 prices), IBM Plex Mono only for SKUs and stock counts. Radii: 12px cards, 8px buttons, 999px pills.
LAYOUT: 64px utility nav with store name, category links, search field and cart icon with count badge; below, a clean collection hero (headline + one trust line, no photo overload); product grid 4-col — photo on #F6F6F7, title, rating stars, price, green Add button; trust row (returns/shipping/reviews with icons); a subscription-upsell band; footer with payment-method marks. A cart drawer (320px) lives off-canvas right with line items, quantity steppers, rolling subtotal and a green checkout button.
MOTION: Add-to-cart flies a 40px thumbnail along an arc to the cart icon over 500ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) (FLIP technique), badge pulses 200ms; drawer slides in 280ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,.24,1) with 200ms backdrop fade; subtotal digits roll odometer-style 240ms (old slide up, new from below); 'Only 3 left' badges pulse opacity over 1.8s, max 3 cycles. Vanilla JS, no libraries.
SIGNATURE: (1) the fly-to-cart arc as the conversion signature; (2) rolling money — subtotal and totals never jump; (3) green reserved exclusively for commerce actions; (4) trust row always within one screen of products.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML with Product microdata (name, price, availability); WCAG AA — verify #6D7175 on white; cart is a focusable dialog (focus trap, Esc close, aria-live subtotal announcements); responsive 4→2→1 columns, drawer full-width under 480px; prefers-reduced-motion replaces fly/roll with instant state updates; images lazy with fixed aspect boxes (zero CLS); total JS < 20KB.

items.name: Terminal CRT Phosphor
items.tagline: Green phosphor glow on near-black terminal glass.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a marketing site for a developer CLI tool in the Terminal CRT Phosphor style — everything on screen must feel like a living green-phosphor terminal.
LOOK: near-black #050A06 background, phosphor green #33FF66 primary text, bright #00FF41 accents, muted #1D8A4A labels, borders #1E4D33. Every text element carries text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0,255,65,.45). Import fonts: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=VT323&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;600&display=swap — VT323 for display, IBM Plex Mono for everything else. Add a scanline overlay (repeating-linear-gradient, 6% opacity) and subtle vignette over the whole page.
LAYOUT: sticky one-line status bar nav with prompt-prefixed links; full-viewport boot-log hero where the headline types out character-by-character below a fake uptime line; features as three ASCII-bordered panels; about section styled as a terminal transcript; CTA as a giant prompt line 'press [ENTER] to deploy'; footer as a single status row.
MOTION: vanilla JS typewriter at 38ms/char with a block cursor blinking 1s steps(2) infinite; scanline overlay drifting 9s linear infinite; phosphor flicker keyframes 0.97–1.03 over 4s; panel hover inverts colors in 120ms ease and prepends '> '.
SIGNATURE: (1) ASCII box-drawing borders around every panel; (2) blinking block cursor after every heading; (3) boot-log lines with millisecond timestamps.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML5, contrast green-on-black passes WCAG AAA, responsive single column under 768px, prefers-reduced-motion kills flicker and typewriter, no external images, all decorative overlays aria-hidden.

items.name: Mission Control NASA
items.tagline: Amber CRT consoles and vector plots, 1970 Houston.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a data-platform marketing site in the Mission Control NASA style — the page must feel like a live 1970s flight-control console, amber phosphor and all.
LOOK: deep brown-black #120B02 background, amber #FFB000 primary readouts, bright #FF8C00 accents, cream #FFE0A3 highlights, borders #3D2A08. All numerals monospaced with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Import: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=VT323&family=Share+Tech+Mono&display=swap — VT323 for giant display digits, Share Tech Mono everywhere else. Console panels sit on #1C1204 surfaces with 2px bezel borders and small-caps labels like 'TELEMETRY — CH 04'.
LAYOUT: top bar with MET elapsed clock (ticks every second) and nav; hero split 60/40 — huge amber count-up KPIs left, live vector-plot chart right; stats band of five console tiles; data table of mission events; timeline of mission milestones as console steps; CTA framed as an 'AUTHORIZE LAUNCH' console switch panel; footer as a console bank.
MOTION: KPIs count up 1.2s ease-out on scroll into view (IntersectionObserver); SVG chart polylines draw via stroke-dashoffset 1.6s ease; GO/NO-GO lamps blink 1.4s steps(2); MET clock ticks live.
SIGNATURE: (1) bezel-framed console panels with small-caps labels; (2) vector-line plots drawn live; (3) the always-ticking MET clock.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML, amber on brown-black meets WCAG AA minimum (use #FFE0A3 for small text), responsive stacks on mobile, prefers-reduced-motion stops blink and count-up, no heavy frameworks.

items.name: Cyberdeck DIY
items.tagline: Hand-built future: amber OLED, greebles, gaffer tape.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a hardware startup's site in the Cyberdeck DIY style — the page must look hand-assembled from salvage, yet stay usable.
LOOK: near-black #0E0C08 background, amber #FFC46B OLED text, hot #FF9E1F accents, tape-cream #E8DCC8 labels, borders #35291A. Import: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Chakra+Petch:wght@600;700&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap — Chakra Petch for headers, Space Mono everywhere. Panels sit on #1A160E metal surfaces with screw-head dots in corners (radial-gradient pseudo-elements) and vent-slat textures.
LAYOUT: top rail styled as a power switch + nav; hero as the deck's main OLED screen with a boot self-test readout; feature grid as bolted modules; product cards with serial-number stamps and stenciled CAUTION labels; settings-panel-style comparison table; CTA as a big red-guard switch; mega footer with a 'schematics' sitemap.
MOTION: OLED panels power on with a 3-step 600ms flicker; modules slide in with cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2) servo overshoot; LEDs blink staggered 2s steps(1); hover draws a skewed masking-tape underline over 240ms.
SIGNATURE: (1) screw and vent greebles on every panel corner; (2) masking-tape labels at slight rotations; (3) serial-number stamps (DECK-042 / REV C).
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML, amber-on-dark text at least 4.5:1 contrast, single-column mobile layout, prefers-reduced-motion kills flicker, textures must be pure CSS — no image assets. Ensure the boot self-test readout in the hero displays believable diagnostics that update on each visit. Keep every panel titled like workshop documentation — 'MODULE', 'BATCH', 'REV' — so the whole page reads as one continuous bench build.

items.name: Hacker Noir
items.tagline: One red accent, monochrome everything, film tension.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a security company's site in the Hacker Noir style — minimal, monochrome, film-noir tension with exactly one red accent.
LOOK: pure #070707 background, #EDEDED grayscale text, #6B6B6B muted, #262626 borders, and blood-red #FF2A2A used sparingly — at most one red element per viewport. Import: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;700&display=swap and use IBM Plex Mono for everything; hierarchy comes from size, weight and case, never color. Surfaces are #111111. Add a fixed film-grain layer (SVG feTurbulence, 4% opacity, animating steps() at 8fps).
LAYOUT: letterboxed hero — thin white rules above and below a full-bleed dark image with a giant monospace title and a blinking underscore cursor; testimonials as isolated quotes with redacted bars that wipe away; FAQ accordion with plus/minus monospace glyphs; nav as a thin uppercase row; CTA section almost empty with one red button.
MOTION: hover inverts elements via mix-blend-mode: difference in 100ms; redaction bars wipe away with scaleX from right over 500ms when scrolled into view (IntersectionObserver); red accent pulses subtly 3s ease-in-out infinite.
SIGNATURE: (1) the single red accent per viewport; (2) redaction-bar reveals; (3) letterbox rules framing the hero.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML, all text at least 4.5:1 contrast, responsive, prefers-reduced-motion stops grain and blinks, zero external images, ship under 50KB.

items.name: Obsidian Glass Dark
items.tagline: Frosted glass layers stacked over glowing black depth.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a fintech dashboard landing page in the Obsidian Glass Dark style — layered frosted glass over glowing black, calm and expensive-feeling.
LOOK: near-black #06070B background with a radial #6C8CFF ambient light bleeding from the top edge; text #E8ECF7, muted #7C86A3, borders #232A3D. Import: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:wght@600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;600&display=swap. Glass panels use background rgba(16,19,28,.55), backdrop-filter blur(20px) saturate(140%), 1px borders with a top-edge highlight and a faint #6C8CFF glow rim (box-shadow inset + outer). A soft cursor spotlight (radial gradient, about 10% alpha, 400px) lerps after the pointer.
LAYOUT: floating pill nav; hero with headline left and one large glass KPI panel right; stats band of four glass tiles; chart-suite section with layered glass charts at three blur planes; settings-panel-style feature list; pricing as three glass tiers with the middle one lifted and brighter; footer as a thin glass strip.
MOTION: spotlight follows the pointer with an 80ms lerp via requestAnimationFrame; panels tilt 2deg toward the cursor (perspective 800px, 300ms ease-out); panels fade-up 20px with 80ms stagger on entry; KPI digits tick up 1.4s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1).
SIGNATURE: (1) visible blur-depth layering between panels; (2) glow rims on every glass edge; (3) the ambient top light.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML, text contrast at least 4.5:1 over glass, provide -webkit-backdrop-filter fallback and a solid-color fallback, responsive stacks, prefers-reduced-motion disables tilt and spotlight.

items.name: Synthwave Grid Horizon
items.tagline: Neon magenta grid racing toward a 1984 chrome sunset.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a music-festival site in the Synthwave Grid Horizon style — full 1984 outrun: neon grid, chrome type, sunset disc.
LOOK: night-purple #0B0221 background graduating through #3B0A66 into a magenta horizon; text #FFE9F7, muted #8F7BD8, borders #3A1E6E. Import: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Orbitron:wght@700;900&family=Rajdhani:wght@500;600&family=Share+Tech+Mono&display=swap — Orbitron 900 for the chrome headline (background: linear-gradient(#fff, #7ab 60%, #123) with background-clip:text), Rajdhani for UI. Neon elements glow with box-shadow/text-shadow in #FF2BD6 and #29F3FF.
LAYOUT: nav with glowing logo mark; full-viewport hero: striped sunset disc behind the headline, grid floor below rendered with a CSS 3D perspective plane (rotateX(60deg), repeating linear-gradient lines) that animates toward the viewer; lineup stats band with neon count-up numerals; a media-player section for the anthem; mega footer with neon sitemap columns; CTA as a giant neon-outlined ticket button.
MOTION: grid floor scrolls via background-position loop 3s linear infinite; a diagonal white sheen sweeps across the chrome headline every 6s; buttons flicker (3-step opacity stutter) then glow steady on hover; hero words ride up from the horizon, staggered 100ms, 600ms each.
SIGNATURE: (1) animated perspective grid floor; (2) striped sunset disc behind chrome type; (3) neon flicker hover on all interactive elements.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML, body text at least 4.5:1 contrast (#FFE9F7 on #0B0221 passes), responsive — grid floor hides on mobile, prefers-reduced-motion stops the grid loop, no video or WebGL required.

items.name: Ledger Precision Crypto
items.tagline: Monospaced numerals on a tick-grid, hash-green truth.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a block-explorer landing page in the Ledger Precision Crypto style — instrument-grade density where alignment is the only decoration.
LOOK: near-black #050807 background with a faint green tick-grid pattern (repeating-linear-gradient, 3% opacity, slowly scrolling); text #D7E4DC, muted #5F7A6C, borders #1C2E26. Import: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;600&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;600&display=swap — all figures, hashes and ids in JetBrains Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; prose in IBM Plex Sans. Confirmations are #00DC82, negative deltas #FF4D4D.
LAYOUT: minimal top bar with network status dot and chain height counter; hero as a giant live balance/height counter in monospace; stats band of four protocol metrics; the centerpiece is a block table — monospace hash columns, confirmation chips, gas and value columns right-aligned; chart-suite section with a line chart and mempool bars; a search form-stack styled like a query console; footer with protocol metadata.
MOTION: balances count up 1.2s linear keeping columns stable; updated rows flash green/red backgrounds fading over 800ms; confirmation chips pulse scale 1→1.06→1 on state change; tick-grid scrolls left 20s linear infinite.
SIGNATURE: (1) the tick-grid substrate; (2) perfectly aligned monospace columns — never centered, never ragged; (3) hash-green confirmation chips.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic table elements with proper th scope, contrast at least 4.5:1, responsive tables become horizontal-scroll cards under 768px, prefers-reduced-motion disables flashes, no images needed.

items.name: Observability Ops Console
items.tagline: Dense charts, status dots, p99 latency histograms.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a monitoring platform's marketing page in the Observability Ops Console style — dense, live and relentlessly informative.
LOOK: navy #0B1220 background, panels on #111B2E with #1E2C4A borders; text #DCE6F5, muted #64789C, primary blue #3B82F6, warn amber #F59E0B, error red #EF4444, ok green #22C55E. Import: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:wght@600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;600&display=swap. Every numeric value renders in JetBrains Mono, tabular-nums. Panels are compact: 12px padding, 1px borders, small-caps titles.
LAYOUT: top nav with a live incident counter badge; hero split as an actual dashboard — headline left, a 2×3 wall of live panels right (sparklines, status grid, p99 histogram); stats band of five KPI tiles counting up; a data-table section listing recent incidents with severity badges; notification-center style alert rail; CTA framed as 'start monitoring in 90 seconds'.
MOTION: sparklines append a point every 2s and shift with a 300ms linear transition (canvas or uPlot); status dots pulse an expanding ring scale 1→2 fading over 2.4s; KPIs count up 1s ease-out when visible; panels lift 2px with accent border on hover in 180ms.
SIGNATURE: (1) pulsing status dot grid; (2) sparkline-prefixed panel titles; (3) severity badge taxonomy used consistently.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML, at least 4.5:1 contrast, responsive — the panel wall stacks under 900px, prefers-reduced-motion freezes sparkline appends, keep JS under 15KB, throttle rAF.

items.name: GitHub Dark Dense
items.tagline: Information-maximal dark UI with syntax-color pop.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a code-platform landing page in the GitHub Dark Dense style — maximum information, zero fluff, developer-native comfort.
LOOK: charcoal #0D1117 background, #161B22 panels, #30363D hairline borders; text #E6EDF3, muted #7D8590, blue #2F81F7, code-green #7EE787, diff-red #F85149. Import: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=Fira+Code:wght@400;500&display=swap. Counters use tabular-nums. Density is high: 12–14px body, 8–12px paddings, tight line heights — but hierarchy stays crisp via weight and muted color, never blur or shadow.
LAYOUT: top nav with search box, org switcher and counter badges; hero as two columns: headline + install command left, a live-looking file browser with tabs right; a diff/PR section showing green and red gutters; stats band (stars, forks, issues) counting up; feature table with row hovers; command-palette CTA section (⌘K hint); footer as a dense link grid.
MOTION: rows wash to rgba(177,186,196,.06) on hover in 120ms; tab underline slides between tabs 200ms cubic-bezier(.3,.7,.3,1); code blocks fade-up 8px on scroll; counters tick up 800ms ease-out.
SIGNATURE: (1) syntax-highlighted code as hero content; (2) red/green diff gutters; (3) the ⌘K command-palette affordance.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML with real table markup, keyboard-navigable tabs (arrow keys), contrast at least 4.5:1, responsive collapse to single column, prefers-reduced-motion removes sliding, keep highlight.js lexers minimal for size.

items.name: Spotify Duotone
items.tagline: Duotone album washes bleeding into near-black.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a streaming-music landing page in the Spotify Duotone style — artwork-driven color, rhythm in the layout, near-black base.
LOOK: #0A0A0A base with a vivid duotone gradient header (#3D1D5E violet fading to transparent over 70%); surfaces #141414, borders #2A2A2A; text #FFFFFF, muted #A7A7A7. Import: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wght@700;800&family=Figtree:wght@400;600&display=swap. Each album card carries its own duotone wash: two-layer linear-gradient tinted by the artwork's dominant hue, with filter: brightness(1.1) on hover.
LAYOUT: persistent top nav with avatar cluster; hero as a playlist header — huge Archivo title over the violet wash; featured album grid of 6 cards each with a giant circular play button hidden at scale(0); track list rows with hover highlight and animated equalizer bars on the playing row; artist spotlight with avatar cluster; toast-system style notification for 'added to queue'; footer with link columns.
MOTION: play buttons scale 0→1 with cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.4) over 200ms on card hover; equalizer bars animate height 0.8s ease-in-out infinite alternate, staggered 120ms; cards lift 4px and brighten over 250ms; header gradient fades with scroll via a throttled scroll listener.
SIGNATURE: (1) per-card duotone washes pulled from artwork hues; (2) the giant circular play button; (3) the 3-bar equalizer as a living status glyph.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML, focus-visible rings on all interactive rows (keyboard users navigate tracks), contrast at least 4.5:1, responsive grid 6→3→2 columns, prefers-reduced-motion stops equalizer.

items.name: Three.js Product Viewer
items.tagline: Orbit the product in a real-time studio stage.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a product page in the Three.js Product Viewer style — a real-time 3D stage where the customer inspects the object like it is in their hands.
LOOK: warm paper-white #F4F2EE background, #FFFFFF surfaces, #1A1A1A text, #8A8578 muted, #E2DFD8 borders, orange #FF5A1F accent for selection states. Import: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400&display=swap. The 3D viewport is full-bleed on desktop (60vh) with a soft radial floor shadow baked under the model.
LAYOUT: slim top nav; hero = 3D viewport occupying most of the viewport with headline overlaid top-left and a vertical swatch rail right (5 colors, active one ringed in #FF5A1F); annotation hotspots on the model opening small spec cards; below, a tab-system (Specs / Materials / Care) with real content; three product-card recommendations; CTA add-to-cart bar that stays sticky on scroll.
MOTION: three.js OrbitControls with enableDamping 0.08 and autoRotate 0.6 until first pointerdown; model entrance via GSAP from y+1.2 with elastic.out(1, 0.6) over 1.2s; swatch clicks tween material.color over 300ms ease-out plus a 500ms key-light intensity pulse; hotspots pulse scale 1→1.15 every 2s.
SIGNATURE: (1) the always-grabbable model — cursor becomes grab/grabbing; (2) swatch rail with live material tween; (3) hotspot annotations tied to spec data.
CONSTRAINTS: load GLTF with Draco compression, show a progress bar during load and a static fallback image if WebGL fails, cap pixelRatio at 2, pause rendering when tab hidden (visibilitychange), semantic HTML, contrast ≥4.5:1.

items.name: WebGL Fluid Hero
items.tagline: Stir the hero; the fluid sim answers your cursor.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building an agency/AI-product landing page in the WebGL Fluid Hero style — a cursor-stirred GPU fluid simulation IS the hero.
LOOK: near-black #04040A base with a #141031 gradient depth; surfaces #0D0D18, borders #1E1E33; text #F2F2FA, muted #8B8BA6; dye colors are luminous cyan #7DF9FF and violet #B26CFF injected into a dark fluid field. Import: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Clash+Display:wght@600;700&family=Satoshi:wght@400;500&display=swap (use fontshare/fallbacks if needed — Space Grotesk + Inter acceptable substitutes). Headline floats ABOVE the canvas at pointer-opposed parallax (0.02 factor, 400ms lerp).
LAYOUT: transparent nav over the sim; full-viewport hero canvas with centered headline + single ghost CTA; below the fold, deliberately calm editorial: feature grid on #0D0D18, an about section, a contact form-stack, mega footer. The contrast between chaotic hero and composed body is the concept.
MOTION: WebGL2 fluid simulation — pointer velocity injects force + dye each frame, dissipation 0.98, curl 12, 60fps target with devicePixelRatio capped at 1.5; idle 4s triggers an autonomous center plume; body sections fade-up 24px staggered 100ms via IntersectionObserver.
SIGNATURE: (1) the sim reacts to every pointer move — no dead pixels in the hero; (2) headline counter-parallax against the fluid; (3) a small fps/quality toggle chip in the hero corner.
CONSTRAINTS: pause the sim when hero is offscreen or tab hidden; provide a static gradient poster + no-sim fallback for reduced-motion and WebGL failure; semantic HTML; body copy contrast at least 4.5:1; total JS for sim under 40KB.

items.name: 3D Typography Extrude
items.tagline: Headlines you can grab, spin and put in shadow.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a design studio site in the 3D Typography Extrude style — the headline itself is a rotatable 3D object.
LOOK: charcoal #101014 background with a warm radial glow from above; text #F5F5F7, muted #8E8E99, borders #2A2A34; the 3D word renders in brushed gold #D4A94E MeshStandardMaterial (metalness .9, roughness .35) with a teal #6FD3C7 rim light. Import: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Unbounded:wght@700;900&family=Inter:wght@400;500&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400&display=swap — Unbounded for any flat display type, which should visually rhyme with the 3D letterforms.
LAYOUT: minimal nav; hero = full-viewport three.js canvas with the extruded studio name (TextGeometry, bevel enabled) center-stage, drag-to-rotate with inertia; a small 'drag' hint bottom-left; stats band (awards, years, projects) in flat type below; a manifesto section; mega footer. Flat 2D type everywhere else keeps the 3D word singular.
MOTION: pointer drag rotates the type group with damping 0.06 and release inertia; environment light orbits at 0.05 rad/s so metal faces shimmer even at rest; double-click snaps rotation to nearest 90° with a 350ms spring; real-time shadow map casts a floor shadow that shifts with rotation.
SIGNATURE: (1) the headline is literally a 3D asset you can spin; (2) continuous env-light shimmer; (3) axis-snap on double-click.
CONSTRAINTS: lazy-init the scene (IntersectionObserver), cap DPR at 2, pause when offscreen, fallback to flat SVG headline if WebGL unavailable, semantic HTML, contrast at least 4.5:1 for body text.

items.name: GPU Particles Galaxy
items.tagline: A million particles obey your cursor's gravity.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building an AI/web3 launch page in the GPU Particles Galaxy style — the hero is a living particle organism with hundreds of thousands of points.
LOOK: void-black #020208 background with a faint #5B8CFF radial nebula; surfaces #0B0B18, borders #1A1A30; text #EAEAFF, muted #6E6E96; particle colors blend #5B8CFF and #C77DFF with per-particle noise variance and distance fog. Import: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400&display=swap.
LAYOUT: transparent nav; full-viewport hero canvas where particles morph between three targets — galaxy spiral (load), brand wordmark (scroll 25%), product diagram (scroll 50%); floating headline + email-capture form-stack over the canvas; stats band (nodes, TPS, countries) counting up; a quiet feature grid; footer. Everything below the hero is calm so the field stays special.
MOTION: GPGPU simulation (FBO ping-pong) at 60fps; the cursor is a gravity well — inverse-square attraction within 180px radius; morph targets lerp over 1.8s ease-in-out driven by scroll progress; per-particle twinkle (size + alpha, 2s noise cycle); CTA hover emits a 600ms radial shockwave through nearby particles.
SIGNATURE: (1) the cursor visibly bends the field — gravity is felt immediately; (2) scroll morphs the same particles between wordmark and diagram; (3) CTA shockwave.
CONSTRAINTS: instanced Points with a single draw call, DPR capped at 1.5, pause offscreen/hidden tab, static nebula-poster fallback for no-WebGL and prefers-reduced-motion, semantic HTML, contrast at least 4.5:1.

items.name: Shader Aurora Gradient
items.tagline: A living aurora breathes behind everything you say.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building an AI/SaaS landing page in the Shader Aurora Gradient style — a living fragment-shader aurora breathes behind calm, confident content.
LOOK: deep navy #070B12 base; the aurora shader blends teal #4FD1C5, violet #A78BFA and rose (#E879A6) silk waves via fbm noise with domain warping, scrolling at 0.05 speed, dithered with blue noise to prevent banding. Surfaces #0E1522, borders #1B2436, text #E9EEF7, muted #71809B. Import: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Instrument+Serif&family=Outfit:wght@400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400&display=swap — Instrument Serif for display headlines, Outfit for everything else.
LAYOUT: glass nav; hero with a large serif headline and one CTA floating over the aurora (no card, let the light show); pricing as three glass tiers whose backdrop-blur refracts the aurora differently at each depth; testimonial wall as glass quote panels; FAQ accordion; thin footer. Content panels always use backdrop-filter so the aurora visibly flows beneath them.
MOTION: shader runs at 60fps with hue palette rotating 12° over 30s; the aurora plane parallaxes 40px behind scroll for depth; panels gain extra backdrop blur on hover (200ms); no other motion — restraint is the signature.
SIGNATURE: (1) the aurora is visible THROUGH every panel (blur refraction); (2) serif display type floating directly on the light; (3) imperceptible 30s hue drift keeping the page alive.
CONSTRAINTS: shader paused when tab hidden or hero offscreen; static CSS gradient fallback for prefers-reduced-motion and no-WebGL; dither to kill banding; DPR cap 1.5; semantic HTML; body text contrast at least 4.5:1 over the darkest aurora regions.

items.name: GLTF Scrollytelling
items.tagline: One model, disassembled by your scroll finger.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a hardware product page in the GLTF Scrollytelling style — one persistent 3D model that scroll disassembles and reassembles like an exploded diagram.
LOOK: charcoal #0F1115 background, #171A21 panels, #252A33 borders; text #EEF1F5, muted #7E8794; ember #FF6B35 highlights the active part, cool #7EC8FF tints idle parts. Import: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wght@600;800&family=Inter:wght@400;500&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400&display=swap (use Archivo wide-stretch if available).
LAYOUT: sticky viewport: the 3D model occupies a fixed 70vh stage while content scrolls beside it. Five pinned caption stages, each 80vh of scroll: (1) overview turntable, (2) shell lifts away, (3) circuit board slides out with hotspot labels, (4) battery and sensors separate with leader lines, (5) full reassembly + CTA. Progress rail on the right shows stage 01–05. Below the scrollytelling, a calm feature grid and mega footer.
MOTION: GSAP ScrollTrigger with scrub 0.5 maps scroll progress to per-part transforms (node names like 'shell', 'board', 'battery' lerp along their axis); captions cross-fade 300ms as stages change; idle turntable rotates 8°/s, pausing on pointer input; active part emissive ramps to #FF6B35 over 400ms while others dim to 60% opacity.
SIGNATURE: (1) the model never leaves the screen — it IS the page; (2) exploded-view scrub synced to scroll; (3) leader-line hotspots on the active part.
CONSTRAINTS: Draco-compressed GLTF under 2MB, lazy-load after first paint, cap DPR at 2, static exploded-diagram fallback for no-WebGL and reduced-motion, semantic captions with real headings, contrast at least 4.5:1.

items.name: Isometric City Diagram
items.tagline: The product map is an isometric city; districts are features.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building an infrastructure platform page in the Isometric City Diagram style — the product shown as a living isometric metropolis where districts are features and roads carry animated packets.
LOOK: slate-navy #101623 background, blocks on #1A2233 with #242E44 edges; text #E9EFF9, muted #6E7C96; amber #FFB03A for the compute district and highlights, green #4FD08C for the healthy/status district. Import: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400&display=swap and a rounded display face (Chillax, or fallback Bricolage Grotesque). The isometric plane uses a 30° grid: each district is an extruded block (CSS transform: rotateX(60deg) rotateZ(45deg) on a parent, or an orthographic three.js scene).
LAYOUT: nav with a tiny live status dot; hero headline above a large isometric cityscape — districts labeled Compute, Storage, Edge, Observability, Payments; roads between them carry SVG dashed packet trails animating continuously; hovering a district lifts it 6px and shows a stats chip; clicking deep-links to that feature's docs section; below, a stats band and data table of regional latency; footer with a minimap-style sitemap.
MOTION: packets animate via stroke-dashoffset 2.4s linear infinite; districts rise in a load sequence with 60ms stagger and a spring overshoot; hovered district extrudes with 200ms ease-out; the whole plane drifts ±2° over 30s alternate for ambient life.
SIGNATURE: (1) animated packet trails along the roads; (2) hover-lift + label chips on districts; (3) the corner minimap tracking viewport.
CONSTRAINTS: prefers-reduced-motion shows a static labeled diagram; keyboard users get a district list mirroring the map as real links; contrast at least 4.5:1; keep the CSS-3D version under 30KB JS.

items.name: Raymarch Tunnel Dive
items.tagline: Scroll dives through an infinite raymarched tunnel.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a game/web3 launch page in the Raymarch Tunnel Dive style — the page is a hyperspace tunnel and scroll is the throttle.
LOOK: void #030308 base with a #14062B depth gradient; panels #101021, borders #232346; text #F0EFFF, muted #8282B8; tunnel geometry glows hot pink #FF3D68 with teal #38F2C8 counter-glow. Import: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Michroma&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400&display=swap — Michroma for display, everything techno.
LAYOUT: full-viewport shader hero rendering an SDF tunnel (rings + longitudinal struts) flying toward the camera; a speed HUD readout bottom-right (in mono); between velocity segments, 'docking stations' — solid panels that scale from .92 to 1 when the tunnel decelerates; content order: hero title over the tunnel, three station sections (story, specs, access), final CTA that triggers warp.
MOTION: scroll delta drives a z-velocity uniform (damped 0.9 per frame); rings brighten with proximity via glow falloff in the shader; when velocity ≈ 0 for 400ms, the nearest station docks into view (400ms scale+fade); CTA click fires warp — velocity ×2 and FOV widens 60→75 for 1.5s.
SIGNATURE: (1) scroll literally propels you — stop and you hover; (2) station-dock reveal rhythm; (3) the warp burst on CTA.
CONSTRAINTS: single fullscreen quad shader (no geometry), DPR cap 1.25 (raymarching is expensive), throttle to 30fps on integrated GPUs via adaptive resolution, static poster + normal scroll fallback for reduced-motion/no-WebGL, semantic HTML over the canvas.

items.name: Metaball Gooey Nav
items.tagline: Nav items that melt, merge and bounce like goo.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a creative-tool landing page in the Metaball Gooey Nav style — everything melts, merges and bounces with liquid physics.
LOOK: warm cream #FFF6F0 background with a soft pink radial wash; surfaces white #FFFFFF, borders #EBE0F5; text #2B2140, muted #8A7FA8; goo colors are #7B5CFF and #FF8AC2. Import: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Baloo+2:wght@600;700&family=Nunito:wght@400;600;700&display=swap. Corners never drop below 24px radius; shadows are soft and colored, never gray.
LAYOUT: gooey pill nav where hovering a link makes adjacent pills bulge toward it (SVG goo filter: feGaussianBlur stdDeviation 10 + feColorMatrix contrast); hero with a large morphing blob behind the headline; product cards that wobble on hover; onboarding steps as connected droplets; a metaball loader demo section; footer with rounded link blobs.
MOTION: nav merge uses the goo filter with a 250ms transition; buttons squash to scaleX(1.15)/scaleY(.9) on press and spring back 400ms with elastic easing; the hero blob morphs border-radius between organic shapes every 8s ease-in-out infinite; loader is three metaballs orbiting a center, 1.4s linear infinite.
SIGNATURE: (1) adjacent nav pills visibly merge like mercury; (2) squash-and-stretch on every press; (3) the ever-morphing hero blob.
CONSTRAINTS: goo filter can be GPU-heavy — apply only to nav and small elements, never full sections; provide non-goo fallback under prefers-reduced-motion; semantic nav/ul/li structure; contrast at least 4.5:1 (#2B2140 on cream passes); test on Safari where feColorMatrix needs explicit values.

items.name: Depth-Camera Parallax
items.tagline: Photos split into layers; the cursor walks between them.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a travel-photography site in the Depth-Camera Parallax style — photographs split into 2.5D layers that respond to cursor and scroll like a window into the scene.
LOOK: cinematic dark #0C0F14 base, panels #141922, borders #222A38; text #F2F5F9, muted #8B96A5; warm #FFD166 sunrise accents and cool #5FA8D3 shadow accents. Import: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,500;9..144,700&family=Karla:wght@400;500&display=swap — Fraunces for display with its expressive optical axis, Karla for captions and body.
LAYOUT: letterboxed hero: a mountain-valley photo sliced into 4 stacked planes (foreground rocks, mid trees, far ridges, sky) using absolutely positioned layers with translateZ, pointer parallax moving each at depth-scaled factors (24px/12px/6px/3px); a location caption floats in front at 1.4× factor; gallery of 6 thumbs below, each splitting into 2 layers on hover; image-lightbox opens full-bleed with the deepest parallax; journal/testimonial section; minimal nav.
MOTION: pointer movement lerps layer offsets over 120ms via rAF; scrolling the hero increases separation from 0 to 40px across 150vh; active layer breathes brightness ±2% over 3s; captions drift at 1.4× for a floating feel.
SIGNATURE: (1) visible layer separation — you can see the photo's bones; (2) captions floating IN FRONT of the scene; (3) letterbox bars framing every frame.
CONSTRAINTS: layers are pre-sliced static images (or CSS gradients for the demo) — no runtime depth maps needed; pointer parallax disabled on touch (use device-orientation or scroll only); provide flat fallback for prefers-reduced-motion; lazy-load gallery; contrast at least 4.5:1.

items.name: Scrollytelling Magazine
items.tagline: Pinned visuals, stepped reveals, data woven into narrative
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a scrollytelling annual-report page in the Scrollytelling Magazine style. Ship one polished, self-contained page.

LOOK: Warm paper aesthetic. Use palette hexes exactly: bg #faf7f0, surface #fffdf8, fg #1c1a17, muted #6e6659, accent #b3261e (editorial red), accent2 #2f5d7c (slate navy), border #ded5c3. Fonts: load https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,400;9..144,600;9..144,700&family=Source+Serif+4:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;1,400&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap — Fraunces for display headlines, Source Serif 4 for body columns, IBM Plex Mono for figures and captions. Hairline column rules, generous drop caps, margin chapter numerals.

LAYOUT, in order: (1) sticky masthead bar with brand and thin red scroll progress line beneath it; (2) hero: red kicker eyebrow, giant Fraunces headline, two-column lede; (3) scrollytelling core: a sticky left figure stage (300vh pin) beside three steps of right-column copy, each step crossfading the chart state; (4) stats band with three count-up plates in IBM Plex Mono; (5) a data-table section of regional figures with hairline rules; (6) methodology block with drop cap; (7) full-width CTA band in accent red with white text; (8) footer with ISSN-style mono line.

MOTION: GSAP ScrollTrigger pins the figure stage for 300vh with scrub 0.5; each 100vh of copy swaps the chart state in 0.4s. SVG chart lines animate stroke-dashoffset 1→0 across the pin. Stats count 0→final over 1.4s power2.out with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Copy blocks fade up 16px over 0.6s staggered 80ms via IntersectionObserver.

SIGNATURE: (a) the pinned figure stage with step dots that ignite as states change; (b) red drop caps opening each prose block; (c) annotated data callouts with hairline leader lines pointing into the chart.

CONSTRAINTS: Build responsively with breakpoints at 768px and 1200px; keep all text at WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1 body, 3:1 large); use semantic HTML (header, nav, main, section, article, footer) with descriptive headings; lazy-load below-fold images, defer JavaScript, and keep total JS under 120KB gzipped; ensure every interactive element is keyboard-reachable with a visible :focus-visible state; respect prefers-reduced-motion by disabling scroll-driven animation.

items.name: Horizontal Scroll Epic
items.tagline: Vertical wheel, horizontal journey through cinematic panels
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a cinematic launch page in the Horizontal Scroll Epic style. Ship one polished, self-contained page.

LOOK: Near-black cinematic stage. Palette hexes exactly: bg #101014, surface #191921, fg #f2efe8, muted #8b8a94, accent #e0532f (ember orange), accent2 #d9a441 (brass), border #2a2a35, plus gradient linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(224,83,47,.18), rgba(217,164,65,.06)) on hero panels. Fonts: load https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wght@500;700;800&family=Inter:wght@400;500&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap — Archivo 800 for display, Inter for body, JetBrains Mono for the counter and slates.

LAYOUT, in order: (1) minimal top bar with brand and four links over letterbox black; (2) hero panel: full-bleed image with headline, subline and mono wheel-direction hint 'SCROLL ▼ →'; (3) the core pinned horizontal track of 5 cinematic panels (500vw) each with a mono slate tag, gradient wash and in-panel parallax; (4) spec band with amber numerals; (5) film-credits-style about section in centered columns; (6) CTA panel with reserve button in accent; (7) footer with mono spec line. Fixed rolling counter '02 / 08' bottom-right.

MOTION: GSAP ScrollTrigger pins the track for 500vh and maps x from 0 to -80% with scrub 1. Each panel's inner image parallaxes xPercent -12 relative to its own travel. The counter rolls digits vertically 0.5s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.3,1) on panel change. Letterbox bars ease 12vh→4vh over 1s on entry.

SIGNATURE: (a) the fixed rolling panel counter; (b) cinematic letterbox bars framing every panel; (c) mono chapter slates (PANEL 02 / DAWN LAUNCH) pinned to each frame's lower-left.

CONSTRAINTS: Build responsively with breakpoints at 768px and 1200px; on touch/mobile fall back to native horizontal swipe panels and disable the pin; keep all text at WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1 body, 3:1 large); use semantic HTML (header, nav, main, section, article, footer) with descriptive headings; lazy-load below-fold images, defer JavaScript, and keep total JS under 120KB gzipped; ensure every interactive element is keyboard-reachable with a visible :focus-visible state; respect prefers-reduced-motion by disabling scroll-driven animation.

items.name: Stacking Cards Deck
items.tagline: Feature cards pin, stack and recede like a dealt deck
items.prompt:
