ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a SaaS product-tour page in the Stacking Cards Deck style. Ship one polished, self-contained page.

LOOK: Clean light product aesthetic. Palette hexes exactly: bg #f4f3f8, surface #ffffff, fg #17161d, muted #6d6a7a, accent #5b4bff (electric violet), accent2 #0ea5a4 (teal), border #e3e2ec. items.name: Scroll Morph Sections

items.name: Infinite Marquee Loop

items.name: Y2K Chrome Bubble

items.name: Acid Rave Graphics

CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML; body text contrast — #F2F207 on #0D0D0D is 15:1+, but verify #8C8C3A only on large text; marquee content duplicated for screen readers is aria-hidden with an offscreen readable list; flashing/glitch effects capped (no full-screen strobe — WCAG 2.3.1 three-flashes rule); responsive: marquees slow down on mobile, table stacks under 700px; prefers-reduced-motion kills pulse/glitch/marquee (static lineup list shown); total JS < 8KB.

items.name: Vaporwave Commerce

CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML; VT323 needs ≥20px for readability and AA contrast (#F8E8FF on #1A0B2E passes hugely); scanline/aberration overlays pointer-events none + aria-hidden; cart remains fully functional (add/remove/count); responsive: hero grid scales, cards stack under 700px; prefers-reduced-motion freezes scanlines/grid/flicker and prints prices directly; no real brand names or busts imagery — emoji + CSS only; total JS < 12KB.

items.name: Memphis Milano Revival

ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building an underground zine/music site in the Punk Zine Collage style — photocopied rage, hand-assembled, deliberately crooked but fully functional.
LOOK: aged paper #F2EFE6, white paste-up surfaces #FFFFFF, near-black #1A1A1A, stencil red #D42B1F (the only color that matters), muted #6B6B60. Import fonts: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Special+Elite&family=Courier+Prime:wght@400;700&display=swap — Special Elite for display/headlines, Courier Prime for ALL body, lists, tables and captions. Photocopier grain sits over everything (SVG feTurbulence noise at 5% opacity, flickering).
LAYOUT: nav as a strip of tape-pasted labels (each link on its own slightly-rotated paper scrap); hero headline in ransom-note style — alternating font families/sizes/weights per word, one word in red stencil; sections separated by torn-paper edges (CSS clip-path jagged polygon); photos held down with masking-tape pseudo-elements at ±4deg; a typed gig-listing table; red hand-scrawl annotations (rotated, one per section) that appear after load; stamp badges ('APPROVED BY NOBODY'); footer as the zine back page with contact/address in typewriter mono.
MOTION: grain flickers opacity .04→.07 in steps(8) over 750ms infinite; tape strips lift on hover (rotate +3deg, translateY -4px, 200ms ease, shadow grows); links and stamps hard-invert (fg↔bg, 0ms transition — instant xerox flash); scrawls fade in rotated after 400ms delay when their section enters. No easing curves beyond linear/ease — this aesthetic distrusts smoothness.
SIGNATURE: (1) torn edges between every section; (2) tape as the joining material; (3) ransom-note display type; (4) red scrawl annotations arguing with the layout.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML; WCAG AA — #1A1A1A on paper passes hugely; never animate full-page flicker beyond 5% opacity delta (photosensitivity safe); keep one readable hierarchy under the chaos — headings remain in DOM order; responsive: scrap rotation reduces under 700px, table becomes stacked rows; prefers-reduced-motion kills flicker and scrawl animation; no external images — CSS shapes, emoji stamps and gradient paper textures only; total JS < 6KB.

items.name: Sticker Bomb Pop
items.tagline: Die-cut everything: stickers peel, tilt and pop off the page.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a merch/sticker shop in the Sticker Bomb Pop style — a sticker sheet come alive, playful physics, thick outlines, fully shoppable underneath.
LOOK: pale banana-cream #FFF6D6 background, white #FFFFFF sticker surfaces, near-black #17171B ink AND borders, muted #716C63, hot pink #FF4D6D and sky teal #4CC9F0 as the pop pair, plus banana #FFD60A splashes. Import fonts: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Titan+One&family=Nunito:wght@400;700;900&display=swap — Titan One for display (it IS a sticker font), Nunito 400/700/900 for body and UI. Every card gets the die-cut treatment: 4px black border, 14px radius, 6px 6px 0 hard shadow; hero pieces get a 5px white kiss-cut border plus 3px black outline. No gradients except holographic foil badges.
LAYOUT: nav as a row of rounded sticker chips; hero = tilted collage of 3-4 overlapping stickers with a fat Titan One headline slab, CTA as a pink pop-off button; product row of die-cut cards (image block, title, price, ADD sticker button); a 'sticker sheet' strip showing the whole collection; mega footer with a newsletter sticker and wobbly social chips.
MOTION: stickers drop in from -60px with ±8deg rotation settling on 600ms cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) when scrolled into view; hover peels them (-2deg, scale 1.04, 180ms, shadow grows); nav chips and badges hard-invert in 0ms; decorative stickers wobble ±3deg on 5s phase-offset loops. IntersectionObserver adds .drop to reveal elements.
SIGNATURE: (1) white kiss-cut die-cut borders; (2) 4px black outlines + hard shadows; (3) overlapping rotated collage; (4) foil conic-gradient badges.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML; WCAG AA — #17171B on #FFF6D6 passes hugely, keep pink/teal for accents not body text; stickers decorative layer aria-hidden; ≤1.04 hover scale to avoid layout jank; responsive: collage collapses to a 2-sticker stack under 700px, shadows shrink to 4px; reduced-motion turns drops and wobbles into simple fades.

items.name: Risograph Print
items.tagline: Two spot inks, one happy accident — print imperfection as beauty.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a studio/publishing site in the Risograph Print style — spot-ink posters, misregistration as a feature, print-shop honesty on screen.
LOOK: warm paper #F6F1E7 background, brighter #FCFAF3 surfaces, ink-black #211D19, muted #8A8172, and exactly two spot inks: fluorescent pink #FF48B0 and riso blue #2B44FF. Import fonts: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@700;800&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap — Syne 700-800 for display, IBM Plex Sans for body, IBM Plex Mono for captions/specs. Misregistration technique: headline has data-ink layers — the pink copy offset 3px up-left, blue 3px down-right, text-shadow or absolutely-positioned clones. Halftone fills: repeating radial-gradient dots at 4px pitch. Overprints: overlapping shapes get mix-blend-mode: multiply.
LAYOUT: nav as a thin ink-black rule with mono links; hero = big misregistered headline, halftone blob shapes in pink and blue overlapping behind (multiply), a mono 'EDITION 001 / INK: FLUO PINK + BLUE' spec line; feature grid as print-swatch cards with halftone headers; timeline as a horizontal ink roller strip; footer with colophon-style credits in mono.
MOTION: headline ghost layers drift ±3px apart on 6s ease-in-out infinite alternate; halftone fills roll background-position diagonally 20s linear infinite; multiply blocks saturate 1.15 on hover in 200ms; grain overlay breathes opacity .05→.075 over 4s. IntersectionObserver only for section fade-ups.
SIGNATURE: (1) two-ink discipline — pink and blue only; (2) misregistered duplicates; (3) halftone dot fills; (4) multiply overprint zones; (5) mono spec captions.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML; WCAG AA — #211D19 on paper passes, never set body text in pink or blue on paper (fails); grain overlay aria-hidden and pointer-events:none; responsive: misregistration offset reduces to 2px under 700px, halftone fills may simplify to solid inks; prefers-reduced-motion stops drift and rolls.

items.name: Graffiti Wildstyle
items.tagline: Wildstyle on concrete: spray fades, drips, letters that bite back.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a streetwear/music site in the Graffiti Wildstyle style — the wall as interface, spray and drip everywhere, commerce underneath kept clean.
LOOK: dark concrete #16110D background with a subtle grain/spray texture overlay, raised #221A14 panels, chalk-white #F5EBDD text, muted #9A8C7C, border #3B2F24, spray orange #FF6B00 and teal #35D0BA as the paint pair. Import fonts: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Sedgwick+Ave+Display&family=Barlow:wght@400;600;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap — Sedgwick Ave Display ONLY for display headlines (large sizes, allow ±6deg per-letter tilt), Barlow for body/UI, JetBrains Mono for placard-style captions. Headline fill: spray gradient via background-clip:text with a 2px chalk text-shadow outline. Hero backdrop gets radial spray-mist glows in the two accent colors.
LAYOUT: nav as stencil plates; hero = wildstyle headline with drip SVGs below, a product drop card pinned like a poster, CTA in orange; shop row of 3 product cards with tilted tag badges; a 'crew / stockists' strip in mono; footer as a wall with guestbook-style mono credits.
MOTION: headlines reveal blur(8px)→0 + opacity over 700ms ease-out via IntersectionObserver; drips scaleY 0→1 (transform-origin top) 700ms ease-out starting 300ms after their headline; hover tilts nav items and headline letters alternately ±6deg with 150ms spring; texture overlay flickers opacity .06→.09 in steps(4) 900ms. No JS beyond the observer.
SIGNATURE: (1) wildstyle tilted overlapping type; (2) spray-gradient fills with chalk outlines; (3) SVG drips under headlines; (4) stencil plates; (5) mist glows in accent colors.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML; WCAG AA — #F5EBDD on #16110D passes hugely; Sedgwick Ave never below 28px and never for body; drips and texture aria-hidden; flicker delta ≤3% opacity (photosensitivity safe); responsive: headline clamps via clamp(), letter tilt reduced to ±3deg under 700px; prefers-reduced-motion renders everything static.

items.name: Candy Neobrutalism
items.tagline: Chunky borders, hard shadows, candy colors, radius zero forever.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a startup/tools landing page in the Candy Neobrutalism style — brutalist structure, candy palette, tactile press physics.
LOOK: pale pink #FFF1F7 background, white #FFFFFF surfaces, ink #111111 used as BOTH text and border, muted #5C5C5C, bubblegum #FF5CA8 and grape #7C6CFF as the candy pair, lime #B8F135 for highlights. Import fonts: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo+Black&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;700&display=swap — Archivo Black for display (uppercase), Space Grotesk for body/UI. RULES: border-radius 0 on everything, borders 4px solid #111, shadows 6-8px 8px 0 #111 (never blurred), no gradients.
LAYOUT: sticky nav with bottom border 4px; hero = uppercase Archivo headline with lime highlight blocks behind key words, big purple CTA; 3-col feature grid of bordered cards with colored tag chips; a full-black stats band with lime Archivo numbers; mega footer with bordered columns.
MOTION: buttons press INTO their shadow on :active — translate(6px,6px) while box-shadow collapses 6px→0 in 100ms; hover lifts translate(-4px,-4px) with shadow growing to 12px over 150ms; nav links flash lime background instantly (0ms) on hover; sections rise translateY(24px)→0 400ms ease-out staggered 80ms via IntersectionObserver. No easing curves fancier than ease-out — brutalism distrusts smoothness.
SIGNATURE: (1) 4px borders + hard shadows everywhere; (2) zero radius discipline; (3) highlight blocks behind headline words; (4) press-into-shadow physics.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML; WCAG AA — #111 on #FFF1F7 passes hugely, #111 on lime and bubblegum passes for large/bold text, white text on grape passes for UI; no radius means focus outlines stay visible — keep outline-offset 2px; responsive: grid collapses to 1 col under 760px, shadows shrink to 4px; prefers-reduced-motion kills press/lift transforms.

items.name: Glitch Datamosh
items.tagline: Corrupted on purpose: frames bleed, channels split, signal degrades.
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a music/games/crypto site in the Glitch Datamosh style — corrupted-video aesthetics as a design system, decay executed with precision.
LOOK: near-black #050505 base, raised #101010 surfaces, phosphor-mint #E8FFE8 text, muted #5C7A5C, border #1E3A1E, channel pair: hot magenta #FF2A6D and digital cyan #05D9E8. Import fonts: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Rubik+Mono+One&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;700&display=swap — Rubik Mono One for display, IBM Plex Mono for ALL body/UI/logs. Headline glitch: two absolute ::before/::after clones with content:attr(data-t), colored magenta/cyan, offset ±3px, each clipped to a horizontal band via clip-path polygon and animated with steps(2).
LAYOUT: nav with channel-split hover on links and a buffer% status readout; hero = giant datamoshing headline with data-t attribute, sub in terminal style, magenta CTA; 3-col grid of 'corrupted media' cards — each has a datamosh gradient band area animating background-position in steps(3); a terminal log panel with typed lines; mega footer as an end-of-broadcast card.
MOTION: headline clones shear ±3→±14px in steps(2) bursts at 2.4s and 2.9s loops (offset phases so tears feel random); card mosh bands slide background-position 0→120% over 3.2s steps(3), saturate+blur 1px on hover; scanline overlay (repeating-linear-gradient 4% white) crawls down 8s linear infinite; log lines type on 30ms/char with a ✗ character that flickers to ✓. Vanilla JS ~30 lines for the typewriter.
SIGNATURE: (1) RGB channel-split tears; (2) datamosh gradient bands; (3) scanline crawl; (4) corrupted-terminal log typography; (5) sliced clip-path dividers.
CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML; WCAG AA — #E8FFE8 on #050505 passes hugely, #5C7A5C only for captions; glitch clones aria-hidden and pointer-events:none; glitch bursts ≤150ms and ≤3% viewport displacement (photosensitivity safe); body text NEVER glitches; responsive: disable clone animation under 760px, keep static offsets; prefers-reduced-motion renders single-color static headlines.

items.name: Vogue Editorial Serif
items.tagline: Fashion authority set in didone, whitespace as wealth
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a senior editorial-web art director. Build a single-page fashion magazine site in the Vogue Editorial Serif style for a couture house.

LOOK: Background #FAF8F4, surfaces #FFFFFF, ink #14110F, muted captions #8C8480, accent black #1A1A1A, gold hairlines #B49A5E, borders #E4DED6, soft ivory gradient `linear-gradient(120deg,#FAF8F4,#F1EDE6)`. Import fonts: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;0,900;1,400&family=Jost:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">. Playfair Display for masthead and headlines, Jost for captions in uppercase with 0.2em tracking.

LAYOUT: 1) Slim top bar with issue number and date slug. 2) Giant masthead with hairline rules. 3) Full-bleed hero photograph with clip-path reveal. 4) Editorial spread: two-column text with drop cap. 5) Horizontal lookbook gallery pinned by ScrollTrigger. 6) Pull-quote section at 4rem. 7) Full-width CTA banner in #1A1A1A with ivory text. 8) Editorial footer with columns of tiny links.

MOTION: Use GSAP ScrollTrigger + Lenis. Masthead letters track from 0.3em to 0.05em over 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.77,0,0.18,1); hero image scales 1.08→1.0 over 1.4s on enter; lookbook translates horizontally scrubbed to scroll; captions stagger 90ms rising 14px.

SIGNATURE: (a) masthead with double hairline rules, (b) captions in tiny letter-spaced caps aligned to the photo's bottom edge, (c) a pull-quote with hanging quotation marks.

CONSTRAINTS: Semantic HTML (header/main/section/footer), WCAG AA contrast on ivory, responsive: single column under 768px with masthead scaled via clamp(), lazy-load non-hero images, total JS under 150KB, no layout shift (reserve aspect-ratio boxes).

items.name: Perfume Noir Luxury
items.tagline: One amber glow in the dark, whisper copy
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a luxury fragrance web art director. Build a single-page perfume site in the Perfume Noir style for a niche fragrance house.

LOOK: Background #0B0908, surface #161211, ivory text #F4EDE3, muted #7A6F65, amber accent #D99A3D, deep amber #8C5A2B, borders #2A2320, page wash `radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 20%, #2A1F14, #0B0908 65%)`. Import: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;1,300;1,400&family=EB+Garamond:ital@0;1&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">. Cormorant Garamond for display, EB Garamond italic for whisper copy.

LAYOUT: 1) Minimal letter-spaced nav. 2) Full-viewport hero: centered bottle in an amber spotlight, one-line tagline. 3) Scent-note pyramid section (top/heart/base) with hairline dividers. 4) Full-bleed atmospheric photography strip. 5) Single testimonial in italic. 6) Quiet footer with boutique addresses.

MOTION: Cursor spotlight = 600px radial gradient lerping to pointer at 0.08 ease, mix-blend-mode screen, rAF-driven. Bottle floats ±10px over a 6s ease-in-out loop. Note items fade up 400ms staggered 200ms on intersection. Smoke layer parallaxes at 0.4x scroll.

SIGNATURE: (a) the amber cursor spotlight, (b) scent-note pyramid with hairline connectors, (c) whisper copy in italic serif at 2rem and 60% opacity.

CONSTRAINTS: Semantic HTML5 landmarks, WCAG AA — keep body text ≥ #B8AC9E equivalent on black; prefers-reduced-motion disables float/spotlight drift; responsive: hero stacks, spotlight becomes a static vignette on touch; images use srcset; no CLS.

items.name: Watchmaker Precision
items.tagline: Exploded diagrams, guilloché patterns, horological spec tables
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a technical-luxury web engineer. Build a single-page watchmaker site in the Watchmaker Precision style.

LOOK: Paper bg #F5F3EF, white surfaces #FFFFFF, ink #1C1A17, muted #6E6A63, champagne accent #9A7B3F, steel blue #3E4A52, borders #D8D3CA, no gradient. Import: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Marcellus&family=Source+Sans+3:wght@300;400;600&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">. Marcellus for display, Source Sans 3 for body, IBM Plex Mono for spec values.

LAYOUT: 1) Top nav with caliber index. 2) Hero: exploded movement diagram with draw-on-scroll strokes and numbered callouts. 3) Craftsmanship narrative with drafting annotations. 4) Full spec table (mono numerals, hairline rules, alternating rows). 5) Detail-crop grid alternating macro photography and line art. 6) Stats band counting up jewels/Hz/reserve. 7) Footer with service + heritage columns.

MOTION: SVG diagrams draw via stroke-dashoffset over 1.6s ease-in-out on intersection (GSAP ScrollTrigger). Guilloché pattern rotates 360°/120s linear. Spec numbers count up 900ms ease-out. Exploded layers separate 40px, 700ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), staggered 120ms.

SIGNATURE: (a) numbered exploded diagram with leader lines, (b) faint engine-turned guilloché texture, (c) mono-numeral spec table with hairline rules.

CONSTRAINTS: Semantic HTML (table elements for specs), AA contrast, responsive: diagram scales via viewBox, table becomes stacked rows under 640px; lazy 3D load only on request; reduced-motion stops rotation; no horizontal overflow.

EXTRA: Serve the diagram as inline SVG so strokes are animatable; add a sticky caliber quick-nav on desktop; date all footnotes; keep charts in #3E4A52 only; hero LCP under 2s on 4G.

items.name: Gallery White Cube
items.tagline: Museum walls, artwork floating, captions in tiny caps
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are an exhibition designer for the web. Build a single-page gallery site in the Gallery White Cube style.

LOOK: Absolute white bg #FFFFFF, off-white surface #F7F7F5, ink #111111, muted #9A9A96, border #EAEAE7, secondary gray #8A8F98, no gradients. Import: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">. Inter at two scales only: tiny uppercase 11px letterspaced captions and large light-weight titles.

LAYOUT: 1) Whisper top bar (name left, hours right). 2) First wall: one artwork centered with huge margins and floor shadow. 3) Rooms 01–04 as alternating full-width and offset walls, each one work. 4) Artist statement on a single narrow column. 5) Exhibition footer: address, hours, colophon.

MOTION: IntersectionObserver triggers: artwork settles from translateY(24px) 800ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); captions slide 12px left-to-right 500ms after 150ms delay. Hover lifts work 4px with soft shadow, siblings dim to 0.85. Lightbox: 300ms cross-fade with 0→8px backdrop blur. All motion 200–800ms, nothing bouncy.

SIGNATURE: (a) tiny caps caption format 'ARTIST — Title, Year, Medium, Dimensions', (b) numeric room markers 01/02/03 as nav, (c) hairline floor shadow under each work.

CONSTRAINTS: Semantic <figure>/<figcaption>, alt text on all works, AA contrast (muted only for non-essential), responsive: margins shrink via clamp, lightbox swipeable on touch; images preloaded only for next room; prefers-reduced-motion kills transitions.

items.name: Champagne Art Nouveau
items.tagline: Whiplash lines, gold on cream, Mucha ornament
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are an ornamental web artisan. Build a single-page champagne/spirits site in the Champagne Art Nouveau style.

LOOK: Cream bg #F7EFDC, lighter surface #FDFAF1, warm ink #3B2E1E, muted gold #93855F, gold accent #B98A2F, botanical sage #6E7F4E, border #E3D5B4, soft cream gradient `linear-gradient(160deg,#F7EFDC,#F2E4C4)`. Import: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel+Decorative:wght@400;700&family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">. Cinzel Decorative for display capitals, Cormorant Garamond for body.

LAYOUT: 1) Nav with medallion wordmark center. 2) Hero: arched image mask of the bottle, ornamental corners, headline in decorated capitals. 3) Heritage timeline as vertical vine with node medallions. 4) Cuvée product cards in arched frames. 5) Tasting-notes section with botanical dividers. 6) Ceremonial CTA band. 7) Ornamental footer with gold rule crest.

MOTION: SVG vines draw on over 2s ease-in-out via stroke-dashoffset (ScrollTrigger). Corner botanicals sway ±2° over 5s infinite. Gold shimmer sweeps background-position 3s every 6s on accent text. Arched frames unmask via expanding clip-path ellipse, 700ms cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1).

SIGNATURE: (a) arched window-frame image masks with double gold outline, (b) floral swash capital at each section opening, (c) laurel medallion badges.

CONSTRAINTS: Semantic HTML, AA contrast (ink on cream passes; gold only for large text/decor), responsive: arches keep aspect-ratio, border ornament hidden under 480px; SVG ornaments inline for zero requests; reduced-motion stops sway/shimmer.

items.name: Heritage Monogram House
items.tagline: Monograms, crests, small-caps serif, centenary gravitas
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a brand heirloom web designer. Build a single-page heritage-house site in the Heritage Monogram style.

LOOK: Ivory bg #F4F0E6, warm surface #FBF8F0, forest ink #232A22, muted #7C7A6C, antique gold #8A6D2F, heritage green #2E4434, border #DDD4BE, no gradients. Import: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+SC:wght@400;500;600&family=Lora:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;1,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">. Cormorant SC small caps for display, Lora for body.

LAYOUT: 1) Crest medallion header + small-caps nav. 2) Hero with founding-date statement and gold rule. 3) Heritage timeline (engraved nodes). 4) Collection cards with certificate-style double borders and № numbering. 5) Stats band (years, ateliers, editions). 6) Quiet CTA. 7) Footer with maison addresses and small-caps columns.

MOTION: Crest embosses in (opacity + scale 0.97→1, 900ms ease-out). Monogram tile background parallaxes at 0.2x scroll via transform. Edition numbers count up 1s ease-out. Gold rules extend width 0→100% over 600ms on entry (ScrollTrigger).

SIGNATURE: (a) repeating monogram tile at ~4% opacity, (b) certificate-style double-rule borders on cards, (c) '№' edition numbering and founding date as recurring motifs.

CONSTRAINTS: Semantic HTML, AA contrast, responsive: monogram pattern via SVG data-URI, cards stack under 720px; count-up respects prefers-reduced-motion (jump to final value); fonts subset weights; no third-party trackers.

EXTRA: Generate the monogram tile as an SVG data-URI; add a subtle paper-grain overlay at 2% opacity; edition numbers must be roman-free arabic; keep all rules 1px; preload the display font only.

items.name: Sneaker Drop Hype
items.tagline: Countdowns, raffle queues, oversized product, street energy
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a streetwear launch engineer. Build a single-page sneaker drop site in the Sneaker Drop Hype style.

LOOK: Black bg #111111, surface #1C1C1C, off-white #F5F5F0, muted #8E8E8A, lime accent #D7FF3E, coral #FF4D2E, border #2E2E2C, subtle gradient `linear-gradient(135deg,#111111,#1E2410)`. Import: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo+Black&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;700&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">. Archivo Black display, Space Grotesk body, Space Mono timers.

LAYOUT: 1) Slim nav + live drop status pill. 2) Hero: giant countdown row, oversized sneaker breaking the grid, drop name in poster type. 3) Velocity marquee ticker. 4) Size-selector chips (some struck through sold-out). 5) Raffle queue card with live position. 6) Colorway thumbnails row. 7) Sticky ENTER RAFFLE bar. 8) Footer with legal fine print.

MOTION: Countdown digits flip with rotateX 300ms spring cubic-bezier(0.68,-0.55,0.27,1.55) per change. Marquee base speed ×3 for 600ms after scroll bursts (rAF velocity observer). Hero shoe slides in from right 800ms power4.out with overshoot rotation. Queue number pulses 1→1.06→1 every 2s. All GSAP ScrollTrigger + rAF.

SIGNATURE: (a) mono flip countdown, (b) sneaker photo breaking the type grid, (c) sticky neon raffle bar.

CONSTRAINTS: Semantic HTML, AA contrast on dark (lime text large-only), responsive: countdown wraps 2×2 under 640px, marquee still runs; countdown computed client-side from a fixed drop timestamp; prefers-reduced-motion = static numerals; images AVIF/WebP.

items.name: Jewelry Vitrine
items.tagline: Museum vitrine light on black velvet, macro sparkle
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a high-jewelry web art director. Build a single-page jewelry vitrine site.

LOOK: Velvet black bg #0D0C0B, surface #171513, champagne-ivory text #EFE7DA, muted #8A8078, gold accent #C9A227, steel-blue secondary #5C6B73, border #26221E, vignette gradient `radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%, #1E1913, #0D0C0B 70%)`. LAYOUT: 1) Hairline gold nav with serif wordmark. 2) Hero vitrine: centered piece under cursor spotlight, spec caption beneath. 3) Collection rail of dimly lit piece cards. 4) Featured piece page-section with 360° turntable. 5) Atelier story strip with two macro crops. 6) Private-appointment CTA. 7) Footer with boutiques.

MOTION: Cursor spotlight = 500px radial gold-white gradient lerped to pointer (0.1 factor, rAF), mix-blend screen. Hover triggers star-flare sweep via masked gradient 900ms ease-out. Cards rise 20px/fade 600ms staggered 100ms. three.js turntable: 15°/drag with 2s inertial decay.

SIGNATURE: (a) cursor-tracked vitrine light, (b) star-flare glint on hover, (c) tiny-caps spec line '1.2 ct • brilliant • 18k yellow gold' under each piece.

CONSTRAINTS: Semantic HTML, AA contrast for body text (gold only decorative/large), reduced-motion = static vignette, no autoplay video, three.js bundle lazy-loaded after LCP, image srcset with retina variants, keyboard-accessible turntable (arrow keys rotate).

EXTRA: Add a metal-type selector (yellow/white/rose) that swaps material uniforms in three.js; keep renderer pixel-ratio capped at 2; provide a static poster fallback if WebGL is unavailable.

items.name: Boutique Hotel Tactile
items.tagline: Linen textures, warm neutrals, editorial calm booking
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a hospitality web designer. Build a single-page boutique hotel site in the Boutique Hotel Tactile style.

LOOK: Linen bg #F5F1EA, surface #FDFBF7, warm ink #2E2A24, muted #8F877B, terracotta accent #A8683C, sage #6B7257, border #E0D8CB, gradient `linear-gradient(180deg,#F5F1EA,#EFE7DA)`. Import: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,400;0,9..144,600;1,9..144,400&family=Karla:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">. Fraunces display, Karla body.

LAYOUT: 1) Serif nav with room-key icon. 2) Hero: full-bleed sunlit suite photo, booking capsule bar (check-in/out, guests, CHECK AVAILABILITY). 3) Rooms: three editorial cards with parallax images and italic captions. 4) Dining & spa: alternating image/text spreads. 5) Neighborhood strip with illustrated map hints. 6) Guest note (single quote). 7) Wide serif footer with address, hours, phone.

MOTION: GSAP ScrollTrigger parallax — photo layers drift at 0.85/1.0/1.15 speeds. Images settle 1.05→1 scale over 1.2s ease-out. Booking date chips breathe scale 1→1.01 over 4s. Rates count up 700ms ease-out. Use Lenis for scroll smoothing (disabled on touch).

SIGNATURE: (a) linen grain texture background (SVG noise data-URI at 3%), (b) floating booking capsule, (c) italic serif editorial captions.

CONSTRAINTS: Semantic HTML, AA contrast, responsive: booking capsule stacks vertically under 720px, parallax reduced to static on mobile; flatpickr date-range with min 1-night validation; lazy images; prefers-reduced-motion honored.

EXTRA: Include a tide-timetable strip in the footer as a signature nod; rooms section uses alternating text/image order; add aria-labels on the booking capsule fields; fallback poster images for all photography.

items.name: Cosmetics Soft Glam
items.tagline: Blush gradients, glass product shots, fluid serif loops
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a beauty-brand web stylist. Build a single-page cosmetics site in the Cosmetics Soft Glam style.

LOOK: Blush bg #FBF1EE, white surface #FFFFFF, deep rosewood text #3D2A2A, muted #A08A88, rose accent #D77A8C, champagne gold #C9A24B, border #F0DED8, signature gradient `linear-gradient(135deg,#FBF1EE,#F6DDE2 55%,#F1E7D3)`. Import: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Italiana&family=Nunito+Sans:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;1,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">. Italiana display, Nunito Sans body.

LAYOUT: 1) Glassy sticky nav with cart count. 2) Hero: product in glass card over gradient, fluid serif headline, one gold word. 3) Shade finder: swatch chips row + cross-fading product image. 4) Bestsellers grid with review stars and skin badges. 5) Tutorial strip: three silent looping videos. 6) Ingredient story with soft icons. 7) Footer with newsletter in rounded input.

MOTION: Gradient background shifts position over 12s ease-in-out infinite. Cards tilt ±6° toward cursor (400ms spring, GSAP) with tracking specular highlight. Swatch clicks cross-fade imagery 500ms. Videos loop with 1s edge fades, autoplay muted playsinline.

SIGNATURE: (a) glass-effect cards with specular tracking, (b) ring-selected circular swatch chips, (c) one gold word per headline.

CONSTRAINTS: Semantic HTML, AA contrast (rose accents only for large text/buttons with white text OK), videos: no audio, data-saver poster images, reduced-motion kills tilt/gradient animation; cart drawer focus-trapped; images lazy with aspect-ratio boxes.

EXTRA: Shade chips must announce selection via aria-pressed; gradient background lives on a fixed pseudo-element to avoid repaints; review stars are text glyphs with aria-label, not images; cart badge counts persist via localStorage.

items.name: Bloomberg Terminal Amber
items.tagline: Amber-on-black monospace market data, zero frills
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a terminal-emulator UI engineer. Build a single-page market terminal in the Bloomberg Terminal Amber style.

LOOK: Black bg #050505, panel #0E0D0A, amber text #FFB000, dim amber #9C6B00, bright amber #FFD54A, green up #00C853, red down #FF5252, border #3A2E10, no gradients. Import: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">. IBM Plex Mono exclusively, 13px base, uppercase headers.

LAYOUT: 1) Top status line: ALL-CAPS amber, UTC clock right. 2) Main grid of panels: quotes table (8 columns), candlestick chart panel, order book, news headlines. 3) Command line with blinking block caret. 4) Crawling ticker above the function-key bar. 5) Function-key chrome: F1 HELP F2 GOVMT F3 EQUITY F8 NEWS F9 EXECUTE.

MOTION: Quote cells flash bg amber 400ms on change (add/remove class). Green/red flash for direction. Ticker crawls 60px/s via rAF, pauses on hover. Caret blinks 530ms step-end. Row insert expands 150ms. No easing libraries — keep it raw.

SIGNATURE: (a) box-drawing-character panel borders, (b) function-key chrome bar, (c) blinking block caret command line.

CONSTRAINTS: Semantic <table> for quotes with proper <th scope>, tabular-nums everywhere, AA contrast is inherent (amber on black = 9:1), keyboard-first: number keys jump panels, `/` focuses command line; throttle DOM updates at 250ms; no layout shift (fixed row heights); reduced-motion stops ticker.

items.name: Quant Grid Tableau
items.tagline: Sparklines everywhere, dense filters, export buttons ready
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a BI dashboard engineer. Build a single-page analytics workspace in the Quant Grid Tableau style.

LOOK: Slate bg #F4F6F8, white surface #FFFFFF, ink #1F2933, muted #6B7785, teal accent #0E7C86, signal orange #E86A33, border #D9E0E7, no gradients. Import: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">. Inter for UI, JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums for every figure.

LAYOUT: 1) Top bar: workspace name, saved-views dropdown, export button. 2) KPI strip: four stat cards with deltas. 3) Main split: left filter rail (facets, range sliders), right data table with sparkline column, sortable headers, sticky first column. 4) Right detail drawer opens on row click with a line chart. 5) Pagination footer with rows-per-page.

MOTION: uPlot sparklines draw 500ms ease-out on intersection. Filter changes re-render rows with 250ms fade + 20ms stagger. Sort arrow rotates 200ms. Toasts slide up 300ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), auto-dismiss 4s.

SIGNATURE: (a) inline sparkline column, (b) faceted filter rail with live result counts, (c) export dropdown that actually triggers a CSV download client-side.

CONSTRAINTS: Semantic <table> + <button aria-sort>, row virtualization past 500 rows, keyboard: arrows navigate cells, `f` focuses filters; AA contrast; responsive: filter rail collapses to a drawer under 1024px; debounce filters 150ms; no external chart bloat — uPlot is ~40KB.

items.name: Clinical White Medical
items.tagline: Precise whites, calm teal, iconographic clarity, zero risk
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a healthtech UI engineer with an accessibility mandate. Build a single-page clinic site in the Clinical White Medical style.

LOOK: Near-white bg #FAFCFD, white surface #FFFFFF, deep teal-ink #16323B, muted #5E7A85, clinical teal #0E7C9E, confirmation green #3BA272, border #D7E4EA, no gradients. Import: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Source+Sans+3:wght@400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">. Source Sans 3 only; hierarchy via weight and size.

LAYOUT: 1) Accessible nav with skip-link. 2) Hero: stroke-drawn icon + headline + single BOOK APPOINTMENT CTA. 3) Patient-flow stepper (3 steps with connectors). 4) Services grid of line-icon cards. 5) Insurance & billing callouts with teal left rules. 6) FAQ accordion. 7) Trust footer: accreditations, privacy, contact.

MOTION: Icons stroke-draw 800ms ease-in-out via dashoffset on intersection. Stepper connector eases width 300ms per step. Status pills pop scale 0.9→1 200ms. Cards float ±4px 6s (disable on reduced-motion).

SIGNATURE: (a) stroke-drawn icon system, (b) status pill vocabulary (scheduled/confirmed/complete), (c) teal left-rule callouts in plain language.

CONSTRAINTS: WCAG 2.2 AA minimum: 4.5:1 body contrast, focus-visible rings, 48px touch targets, aria-live for status changes; semantic headings h1→h2→h3; forms with labels + inline errors; responsive: stepper becomes vertical under 640px; zero decorative animation without reduced-motion support.

EXTRA: Add a printable visit-prep checklist section; phone numbers are tel: links; every service card links to a plain-language detail page stub; ensure headings skip no levels; test with keyboard only.

items.name: Legal Document Serif
items.tagline: Numbered clauses, serif body, margin annotations, gravitas
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a legal-publishing web typesetter. Build a single-page terms/contract site in the Legal Document Serif style.

LOOK: Paper bg #FDFBF6, white surface #FFFFFF, ink #1F1B16, muted #7A7268, oxblood accent #7A2E2B, slate blue #2F4858, border #E2DACC, no gradients. Import: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=EB+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400&family=Courier+Prime:wght@400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">. EB Garamond everywhere textual, Courier Prime for annotations and dates.

LAYOUT: 1) Masthead with double rule. 2) Preamble. 3) Articles as numbered clauses (CSS counters: 1 / 1.1 / 1.1.2) with hanging indents at 68ch measure. 4) Margin annotations via a two-column grid on wide screens. 5) Definitions section with oxblood small-caps terms. 6) Signature blocks with dotted lines. 7) Footer with drawn wax seal.

MOTION: Clauses rise 12px + fade 500ms ease-out staggered 60ms (IntersectionObserver). Margin notes slide in 300ms when their clause centers. Defined-term hover highlights all references 400ms via JS class toggle. Seal draws 2s stroke animation.

SIGNATURE: (a) CSS-counter clause numbering with hanging indents, (b) margin-note grid with connecting hairlines, (c) oxblood defined-term linking.

CONSTRAINTS: Semantic <ol>/<section> structure, print stylesheet (@media print: hide motion, black on white), AA contrast, responsive: margin notes collapse to inline footnotes under 960px; anchor links for cross-references with :target highlight; no JS frameworks needed.

EXTRA: Include Schedule A/B stub anchors at the end; clause hover shows a subtle left-rule marker; document title in the browser tab matches the masthead; keep line length 65-70ch measured in characters.

items.name: RealEstate Map Modern
items.tagline: Split map/list, synced pins, price overlays, tour CTAs
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a proptech front-end engineer. Build a single-page property search in the RealEstate Map Modern style.

LOOK: Pale bg #F7F8F7, white cards #FFFFFF, ink #1D2733, muted #64748B, forest accent #1E6E5C, coral highlight #E85D3D, border #E2E8E6, no gradients. Import: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">. DM Sans with tabular-nums for prices.

LAYOUT: 1) Toolbar: location input, bed/bath/price chips, save-search, map toggle. 2) Split body: left map with custom price-pill markers; right virtualized card list (photo, price, beds/baths/sqft, heart). 3) Hover sync both directions. 4) Mobile: map toggles full-screen, filter bottom-sheet.

MOTION: Hover pin pulse scale 1→1.3→1 600ms both ways. Cards slide in 350ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) staggered 40ms on new results. Price pills fade-scale 250ms post tile-load. Filter sheet springs 400ms with overshoot.

SIGNATURE: (a) price pills as map markers, (b) two-way card↔pin hover sync, (c) draw-on-map boundary search.

CONSTRAINTS: Semantic <ul> of results with <article> cards, all interactive elements keyboard-reachable, map has text alternative list; virtualize past 60 cards; debounce map-move queries 400ms; cluster markers past 200; AA contrast; lazy tile + image loading; heart state persists to localStorage.

EXTRA: Price pill markers are DOM buttons with aria-labels like '749000 dollars, 3 bed on 9th'; map and list scroll independently; a compare-tray holds up to three saved cards at the bottom.

items.name: Consulting McKinsey Grid
items.tagline: Action-title charts, exhibition whitespace, navy authority
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a strategy-house presentation engineer. Build a single-page insight report in the Consulting McKinsey Grid style.

LOOK: Warm white bg #FBFBF9, white surface #FFFFFF, navy ink #122A44, muted #5C6B7A, deep navy #0F3D6E, antique gold #C7A252, border #DEE4EA, no gradients. Import: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Source+Serif+4:opsz,wght@8..60,600&family=Source+Sans+3:wght@400;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">. Source Serif 4 for action titles, Source Sans 3 for body and chart labels.

LAYOUT: 1) Title band with report name + date. 2) Executive summary: three KPI stats with verdicts. 3) Exhibits 1–4: each a full-sentence action title, chart, gold-ruled 'So what' box, source footnote. 4) Recommendation section on navy band with white text. 5) Appendix mini-table. 6) Footer with methodology notes.

MOTION: Charts build 900ms ease-out, series staggered 150ms (ScrollTrigger). KPI numbers count up 1.2s then underline draws 300ms. Insight boxes slide 16px 350ms after chart completion. Keep total motion under 2.5s per exhibit.

SIGNATURE: (a) action titles as full sentences, (b) gold-ruled insight callouts, (c) exhibit numbering system.

CONSTRAINTS: Semantic <figure>/<figcaption> per exhibit, data in <table> fallback for screen readers, AA contrast, responsive: charts resize via viewBox + resize observer; print stylesheet collapses to deck feel; reduced-motion = final chart state; no chart lib heavier than D3 core.

EXTRA: Each exhibit footnote cites a fictional internal source line; chart colors limited to navy, gold, and two grays; the executive summary precedes all exhibits and stands alone if read exclusively.

items.name: Insurance Trust Blue
items.tagline: Reassuring mid-blue, shield iconography, stepped claim flows
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a trust-first product designer. Build a single-page insurance site in the Insurance Trust Blue style.

LOOK: Soft blue-white bg #F4F8FB, white surface #FFFFFF, deep navy ink #17324A, muted #5B7893, trust blue #1668B0, confirm green #2E9E6B, border #D5E3EE, gradient `linear-gradient(180deg,#F4F8FB,#E9F2F9)`. Import: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Public+Sans:wght@400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">. Public Sans only — legibility over personality.

LAYOUT: 1) Nav with quote CTA. 2) Hero: shield badge with pulse ring + headline + GET A QUOTE. 3) Claim flow stepper: File → Assess → Resolve with progress rail. 4) Coverage comparison table (checkmark columns). 5) Stats band: claims paid, avg response, years. 6) Plain-language FAQ accordion. 7) Trust footer with licenses.

MOTION: Progress rail fills 400ms ease-out per step, check pops scale 200ms. Shield badges scale 0.92→1 250ms. One teal ring pulse 600ms on load. Premium quote counts up $0→value 900ms ease-out.

SIGNATURE: (a) always-visible claim progress rail, (b) shield/umbrella badge system, (c) 'what happens next' explainer boxes after each step.

CONSTRAINTS: WCAG 2.2 AA, forms with visible labels and inline errors (no alert()), stepper semantic <ol>, AA contrast everywhere, responsive: table becomes stacked cards under 720px; no countdowns/urgency patterns; reduced-motion disables pulse; page works without JS (static flow shown).

EXTRA: Include a coverage-calc teaser input (zip + age) that scrolls to the quote form; every step box repeats the phone number as an alternative path; use sentence case throughout, never shouting.

items.name: Logistics Network Map
items.tagline: Living route arcs between hubs, fleet status sidebars
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a supply-chain visualization engineer. Build a single-page logistics network page in the Logistics Network Map style.

LOOK: Deep navy bg #0C1524, panel #13233A, light text #E8EEF5, muted #7A8CA5, signal orange #FF8A3D, cyan #3FC1C9, border #22354F, gradient `radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 20%, #14294a, #0C1524 70%)`. Import: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@500;600&family=Barlow:wght@400;500&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">. Barlow Condensed display, Barlow body, JetBrains Mono telemetry.

LAYOUT: 1) Top bar with network name + global clock. 2) Main split: left 70% map (world, hub nodes, arcs), right 30% fleet sidebar with ETA rows. 3) Below map: legend with capacity bars, status badge row. 4) Stats band: on-time %, shipments in flight, ports active. 5) Footer with API/ops links.

MOTION: Arcs draw 1.4s ease-in-out then dash-flow animates 2s linear infinite. Hub pulses: ring scale 1→1.8 fade 2.4s staggered. Cargo dot glides along clicked arc 3s linear. Sidebar values tick 200ms mono updates via rAF (throttled 1s).

SIGNATURE: (a) flowing-dash great-circle arcs, (b) pulsing hub throughput rings, (c) live ETA countdown sidebar with status badges.

CONSTRAINTS: Semantic HTML, map aria-labeled with data-table fallback listing routes; AA contrast on dark; pause dash-flow under prefers-reduced-motion; throttle updates; virtualize sidebar past 100 rows; total JS < 200KB.

EXTRA: Add a lane-detail modal on node click listing vessel, draft, and next port; sidebar rows highlight amber when an ETA slips past threshold; the global clock ticks each second in mono.

items.name: Energy Grid Monitor
items.tagline: SCADA flow diagrams, MW counters, alarm state colors
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a SCADA/HMI web engineer. Build a single-page grid monitor in the Energy Grid Monitor style.

LOOK: Near-black bg #111417, panel #1A1F24, light #DDE4E8, muted #77848C, cyan accent #39C6FF, amber #FFC53D, alarm red #FF4D4D, green nominal #3BA272, border #2A333B, no gradients. Import: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Saira+Condensed:wght@500;600&family=Inter:wght@400;600&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">. Saira Condensed labels, Inter body, IBM Plex Mono measurements.

LAYOUT: 1) Operator header: substation name, operation mode, UTC clock. 2) Main: single-line diagram SVG (grid→transformers→buses→loads) with tag labels and flow animation. 3) Alarm tile grid right (state colors). 4) Rolling MW counter band. 5) Trend strip charts bottom. 6) Footer with alarm log link.

MOTION: Connectors dash-offset animate 1s linear infinite (direction). Counters roll digits 400ms ease-out on change. Alarm tiles blink amber 1.2s x3 then hold; critical red holds solid. Trend charts append points every 2s with 300ms slide.

SIGNATURE: (a) animated single-line diagram, (b) ISA-101 alarm color discipline (color = state only), (c) engineering tag numbers on all equipment.

CONSTRAINTS: Semantic HTML, alarms announced via aria-live=assertive, AA contrast, all states also encoded with icons/text (not color alone); WebSocket feed with 5s fallback polling; counters tabular-nums; reduced-motion = static dashes, no blink; diagram keyboard-zoomable.

EXTRA: Provide a 15-minute alarm-log table below the trends; equipment tags are abbreviations with title attributes; add a manual data-refresh button; keep the diagram legible at 320px width with zoom.

items.name: Olympic Broadcast Stats
items.tagline: Lower-thirds, medal tables, split-time animations, broadcast energy
items.prompt:
ROLE: You are a broadcast-graphics engineer building for the web. Create a single-page sports results hub in the Olympic Broadcast Stats style.

LOOK: Navy bg #0A1F3C, panel #122B52, white text #FFFFFF, muted #8FA6C4, red accent #E8352E, gold #C9A227, border #1E3D6B, gradient `linear-gradient(135deg,#0A1F3C,#16345F)`. Import: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wght@600;700;800&family=Inter:wght@400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">. Archivo for broadcast display, Inter for stats.

LAYOUT: 1) Event header with discipline + session code. 2) Hero lower-third: athlete name, lane, PB in banner form. 3) Results table with medal chips and record tags. 4) Split-time bar comparison (ranked, gold=winner). 5) Medal standings band with count-ups. 6) Upcoming heats ticker. 7) Footer with federation links.

MOTION: Lower-thirds slide from left 450ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) with wipe mask. Split bars grow width 800ms ease-out staggered 100ms by rank. Medal counts roll 900ms. WR/AR tags flash scale 1.15→1 once, 500ms.

SIGNATURE: (a) broadcast lower-third banners, (b) metal-chip medal table, (c) ranked split-time bars.

CONSTRAINTS: Semantic <table> for results with <th scope>, AA contrast (white on navy passes; red/gold only for accents), lower-thirds trigger once via IntersectionObserver, ticker pauses on hover and reduced-motion; data hardcoded in a JS array (no API needed); responsive: bars keep % widths, table scrolls horizontally with sticky first column.

EXTRA: Add lane assignments as a second table column; wind reading appears as a small badge on the results header; ticker items are anchors to the schedule section; medal chips use radial metal gradients.

items.name: Taisho Deco Japanese
items.tagline: Tokyo 1925: lantern glow, lattice, quiet glamour
items.prompt: ROLE: Build a single-page site for a Taisho-era Japanese craft brand in the Taisho Deco Japanese style. LOOK: background #F6EDDE, surfaces #FDF8EE, text #2B2118, muted #8A7A66, accents #C1442E (vermilion) and #3E6E5B (pine), border #E0CFB2, with a soft cream linear-gradient wash. Load fonts via https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Shippori+Mincho:wght@500;700&family=Zen+Kaku+Gothic+New:wght@400;500&display=swap — Shippori Mincho for display, Zen Kaku Gothic New for body. LAYOUT in order: (1) header with brand mark, four links, vermilion CTA button; (2) hero with a large Mincho headline, one supporting paragraph, and a decorative asanoha lattice band; (3) three-card feature grid describing craft, material, and provenance; (4) about section with a vertical-rule flourish and seal stamp; (5) full-width vermilion CTA band; (6) footer with columns and a hanko mark. MOTION: use IntersectionObserver to fade+translateY(18px) panels over 500ms with 90ms stagger; animate SVG lattice borders with stroke-dashoffset over 600ms ease-out; add a slow 6s lantern-glow opacity pulse on the hero accent; give the footer seal a 400ms spring stamp-in. SIGNATURE: (a) every section framed by thin double rules with a center diamond, (b) a vermilion hanko seal motif used at least twice, (c) a vertical rule line with small caption text along the hero edge. CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML (header/nav/main/section/footer), contrast ratio at least 4.5:1 for body text, responsive single-column layout below 760px, no external JS libraries, total page under 150 lines excluding SVG paths, lazy-load any images.

items.name: Korean Pastel Webtoon
items.tagline: Scroll episodes, speech bubbles, pastel panel glow
items.prompt: ROLE: Build a single-page site for a webtoon/entertainment platform in the Korean Pastel Webtoon style. LOOK: background #FFF7FA with a pastel linear-gradient(#FFF0F6,#EAF9FB) wash, white panels, text #3A2E44, muted #9B8AA6, accents #FF7EB6 (bubble pink) and #7ED0D6 (mint), border #F2DCE8. Load https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Jua&family=Noto+Sans+KR:wght@400;500;700&display=swap — Jua for display, Noto Sans KR for body. LAYOUT in order: (1) sticky header with rounded logo chip and pill nav; (2) hero: giant speech-bubble headline with CSS tail, subtitle, two bubble-shaped buttons, and a row of comic panel thumbnails; (3) scroll-snap episode strip of 3–4 full-height panels each with an EP chip and caption bubble; (4) feature grid of three rounded cards for genres or apps; (5) about blurb with floating stickers; (6) pink CTA band styled as a rounded panel; (7) footer. MOTION: bubbles pop in with scale 0.6→1.04→1 over 320ms spring easing; use CSS scroll-snap with a sticky progress dot rail; add infinite typing-dots animation (three dots, 150ms stagger); stickers tilt ±6deg on hover over 250ms. SIGNATURE: (a) all primary buttons are speech bubbles with tails, (b) an EP.01-style episode chip system, (c) floating sparkle decorations. CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML, 4.5:1 text contrast, single column below 760px, no JS frameworks, CSS-only motion, images lazy-loaded. DELIVERY: Ship one self-contained index.html. Define CSS custom properties --bg:#FFF7FA, --surface:#FFFFFF, --fg:#3A2E44, --muted:#9B8AA6, --accent:#FF7EB6, --accent2:#7ED0D6, --border:#F2DCE8 on :root and use them everywhere — no hard-coded colors. Preconnect to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com, load Jua, Noto Sans KR with display=swap and a system-font fallback stack to prevent layout shift. Implement the motions (bubble pop, episode snap, typing dots, sticker tilt) exactly as specified; wrap every ambient loop in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) to disable. Verify before delivery: all headings in a logical h1→h3 order, focus-visible outlines on interactive elements, no horizontal overflow at 360px viewport, and images with width/height attributes to avoid CLS.

items.name: Chinese Ink Brush
items.tagline: Handscroll reading, shuimo washes, vermilion seals
items.prompt: ROLE: Build a single-page site for a Chinese tea house in the Chinese Ink Brush style, reading like a horizontal handscroll. LOOK: background #F7F4EC, panels #FCFAF4, ink text #23272B, muted #7C7F82, single vermilion accent #B03A2E, deep slate #3B4A52, border #DAD4C4; no gradients — ink density provides all shading. Load https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Serif+SC:wght@400;600&display=swap and use it for both display and body. LAYOUT: implement a pinned horizontal-scroll track (GSAP ScrollTrigger, xPercent -60 over 3000px of vertical scroll, scrub 1) containing sections in order: (1) opening hero with ink-wash mountain SVG, vertical headline, and seal stamp; (2) tea origin chapter with three vessel images and colophon captions; (3) brewing timeline as a brush-stroke line with nodes; (4) about chapter with a long-form paragraph in wide measure; (5) closing vermilion seal and contact line. MOTION: brush-stroke SVGs draw in with stroke-dashoffset 900ms ease-in-out; the hero wash de-blurs from 8px/0-opacity over 1.2s on load; seals press in with a 350ms spring. SIGNATURE: (a) at least one vermilion seal per chapter used as a section marker, (b) vertical colophon captions beside images, (c) wide ma negative space between sections. CONSTRAINTS: semantic HTML, 4.5:1 contrast, provide a normal vertical-scroll fallback when JS is off or viewport is under 760px, lazy-load images, total request weight under 1.5MB.

items.name: Jaipur Mandala Symmetry
items.tagline: Mandala symmetry, marigold rose, jali light
items.prompt: ROLE: Build a single-page site for a Jaipur wedding-planning studio in the Jaipur Mandala Symmetry style.
